drillParagraphs.question: Would you agree that women generally show their affection for others more easily than men?

drillParagraphs.question: If someone says they work as a chemist, what kind of work do they do?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, they either work as a scientist in the field of chemistry, or they work in a chemist's selling medicine to the public
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果有人说自己是化学家，那么他们从事什么工作？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，他们要么作为化学领域的科学家，要么作为向公众销售药物的化学家工作

drillParagraphs.question: Which domestic appliance do you feel saves people the most time?
drillParagraphs.answer: The domestic appliance I feel … is … harmony divorce
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为哪种家用电器最节省人们的时间？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我感觉的家用电器……是……和谐离婚

drillParagraphs.question: If there's a lack of harmony in a marriage over a long period, what can it lead to?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果婚姻长期不和谐，会导致什么后果？

drillParagraphs.question: Why do more road accidents occur when it rains?
drillParagraphs.answer: More … roads are slippery, and motorists find it difficult to see
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么下雨天交通事故更容易发生？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 更多……道路很滑，驾车者很难看清

drillParagraphs.question: Does it ever occur to you that perhaps you should adopt a healthier lifestyle?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, it sometimes … ~ No, it never …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否曾经想过也许您应该采取更健康的生活方式？

drillParagraphs.question: What's a beast?
drillParagraphs.answer: A beast is a large and dangerous animal, such as a gorilla
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么是野兽？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 野兽是一种大型且危险的动物，例如大猩猩

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean by a grain of sand, or a grain of rice?
drillParagraphs.answer: By …, we mean one small particle of …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 一粒沙、一粒米是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们所说的……，是指一小部分……

drillParagraphs.question: Does your country produce the majority of its grain domestically or does it import most of it?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 贵国的大部分粮食是在国内生产还是进口？

drillParagraphs.question: What part of the body's this?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 这是身体的哪一部分？

drillParagraphs.question: Do the majority of the inhabitants of your town live in houses or apartments?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你镇上的大多数居民都住在独立屋或公寓里吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Why is it particularly important for people who live in apartments to be considerate towards their neighbours?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么对于住在公寓里的人来说，体贴邻居特别重要？

drillParagraphs.question: Do countries near the equator have a very limited annual temperature range?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 赤道附近的国家年温差是否非常有限？

drillParagraphs.question: Which type of film usually produces a wider range of emotions: a drama or a comedy?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 哪种类型的电影通常会产生更广泛的情感：戏剧还是喜剧？

drillParagraphs.question: How many people is your household comprised of?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您的家庭有多少人？

drillParagraphs.question: What's your least favourite household chore?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你最不喜欢的家务是什么？

drillParagraphs.question: If guard dogs hear footsteps in the middle of the night, do they start barking loudly?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果看门狗在半夜听到脚步声，它们会大声吠叫吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Do burglars tend to avoid burgling properties that have guard dogs?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 窃贼是否倾向于避免盗窃有看门狗的财产？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you think the market for new cars in your country has shrunk in recent years?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为近年来贵国新车市场是否萎缩？

drillParagraphs.question: What do I mean if I say "John had a puzzled expression on his face"?
drillParagraphs.answer: If you …, you mean he looked confused
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我说“约翰脸上带着困惑的表情”是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果你……，你的意思是他看起来很困惑

drillParagraphs.question: What do we call the top of a mountain?
drillParagraphs.answer: We call … the peak or summit
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们所说的山顶是什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们称之为……顶峰或顶峰

drillParagraphs.question: In this part of town, is there a considerable increase in traffic during peak hours?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在城镇的这个区域，高峰时段的交通量是否会大幅增加？

drillParagraphs.question: What do you feel like doing this evening?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 今天晚上你想做什么？

drillParagraphs.question: If you had a nasty cold one weekend and didn't feel up to going out, what would you do instead?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果某个周末你得了重感冒并且不想出去，你会做什么呢？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you feel frustrated when you make silly mistakes?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当你犯愚蠢的错误时，你会感到沮丧吗？

drillParagraphs.question: How would you feel if a train you'd hoped to catch was pulling out from the platform just as you arrived?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果您希望搭乘的火车恰好在您到达时从站台驶出，您会有什么感觉？

drillParagraphs.question: If you dyed your hair a completely different colour, would it transform your appearance?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你把头发染成完全不同的颜色，你的外表会改变吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Under what circumstances do the police decide to restrain someone physically?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在什么情况下警察会决定对某人进行身体约束？

drillParagraphs.question: In a newspaper, where's the sports section usually located?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在报纸上，体育版通常位于哪里？

drillParagraphs.question: What do we call the final section of an essay?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们如何称呼论文的最后部分？

drillParagraphs.question: Why do some people have a preference for wearing glasses rather than contact lenses?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么有些人更喜欢戴眼镜而不是隐形眼镜？

drillParagraphs.question: When we create a piece of writing, like a letter or an essay for example, how can we ensure that we've included all the information we need to, and that our information is clearly organized?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, … by making a simple plan on paper before we start
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当我们创作一篇文章时，例如一封信或一篇文章，我们如何确保我们包含了我们需要的所有信息，并且我们的信息组织清晰？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……，……在开始之前在纸上制定一个简单的计划

drillParagraphs.question: Why is it important to separate our writing into different paragraphs?
drillParagraphs.answer: It's … so that the reader knows when we are changing subject, or starting a new point
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么将我们的写作分成不同的段落很重要？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 这是......以便读者知道我们何时改变主题或开始新的观点

drillParagraphs.question: What must we remember to put at the beginning of any piece of writing?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们必须记住在任何一篇文章的开头写什么？

drillParagraphs.question: Why?
drillParagraphs.answer: So that the reader knows why we're writing and what they're going to read about When should we not use contractions in writing?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 这样读者就知道我们为什么要写作以及他们将要读到什么内容我们什么时候不应该在写作中使用缩写？

drillParagraphs.question: How can we decide whether a piece of writing should be written in a formal style or not?
drillParagraphs.answer: We can … by thinking about who will read it
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们如何决定一篇文章是否应该用正式的文体来写？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们可以……通过考虑谁会阅读它

drillParagraphs.question: When we've finished writing, what kinds of things should we check?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, … our punctuation, spelling and grammar
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当我们写完后，我们应该检查哪些内容？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……，……我们的标点符号、拼写和语法

drillParagraphs.question: Which region of your country is best known for its gorgeous landscape?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你们国家的哪个地区以其美丽的风景而闻名？

drillParagraphs.question: If I was off sick (or took a day off) one day, would someone else come to teach this class or would the lesson be cancelled?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, someone else would … ~ If …, the lesson would be cancelled
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果有一天我生病了（或请了一天假），会有其他人来教这门课吗？或者课程会被取消吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，其他人会……〜如果……，课程就会被取消

drillParagraphs.question: If I say "I'm off now; see you later", what does the word "off" mean?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我说“我现在走了，待会儿见”，“off”这个词是什么意思？

drillParagraphs.question: Do painkillers normally come in tablet form?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 止痛药通常是片剂形式吗？

drillParagraphs.question: And what's the normal dose?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 正常剂量是多少？

drillParagraphs.question: What am I doing?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我在做什么？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you think it's a good idea to keep one's private life distinct from one's work life?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为将私人生活与工作生活区分开是个好主意吗？

drillParagraphs.question: How do you usually occupy your spare time?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你通常如何打发业余时间？

drillParagraphs.question: When teenagers have a party, is there normally a good deal of mess to clear up afterwards?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当青少年聚会时，通常会有很多混乱需要清理吗？

drillParagraphs.question: If it were raining and I said "It looks as though it will clear up soon", what would I mean?
drillParagraphs.answer: If it were …, … stop raining soon
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果正在下雨，我说“看起来很快就会放晴”，我的意思是什么？

drillParagraphs.question: Which aspect of your job (or studies) do you like the most?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您最喜欢您工作（或学习）的哪一方面？

drillParagraphs.question: Would you say you were good at carrying out instructions with great efficiency, or do you have a tendency to take too long getting things done?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, I'd say … ~ No, I wouldn't say …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否认为您擅长高效地执行指示，或者您是否倾向于花费太长时间才能完成工作？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，我会说……〜不，我不会说……

drillParagraphs.question: Do you prefer to travel by land, by sea, or by air?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您更喜欢陆路、海运还是航空旅行？

drillParagraphs.question: If you were a teacher and saw one of your students gazing out of the window during a lesson, would you assume they were not paying attention?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, if I were … ~ No, if I were … thrill thrilling suspense
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果您是一名老师，看到您的一个学生在上课时凝视窗外，您会认为他们没有集中注意力吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，如果我是……~不，如果我是……惊心动魄悬疑

drillParagraphs.question: Do you think the work of a spy would be mostly thrilling or often tedious?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为间谍的工作大部分是令人兴奋的还是乏味的？

drillParagraphs.question: Which famous person would you be most thrilled to meet?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您最高兴见到哪位名人？

drillParagraphs.question: Have you ever had a nickname?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你曾经有过昵称吗？

drillParagraphs.question: How did you get that nickname?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你是怎么得到这个绰号的？

drillParagraphs.question: Do some buses in this town run more frequently on weekdays than at weekends?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 这个镇上的某些公共汽车在工作日的班次比周末的班次多吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you like to be surprised by friends dropping in (dropping by) for a chat, or do you prefer them to give you a ring to let you know they're coming?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, I like … ~ No, I don't like …; I prefer …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否喜欢朋友过来聊天时感到惊讶，或者您更喜欢他们给您打电话让您知道他们要来？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，我喜欢……〜不，我不喜欢……；我更喜欢……

drillParagraphs.question: At a hotel, how can you tell the difference between holidaymakers and those who are there on business?
drillParagraphs.answer: At a hotel, you can tell …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在酒店，您如何区分度假者和商务人士？

drillParagraphs.question: What tip would you offer a holidaymaker who was visiting your country for the first time?
drillParagraphs.answer: The tip I'd offer … would be …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您会给第一次来贵国度假的游客什么建议？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you get irritable if you go without food for a long time?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果长时间不吃东西，你会感到烦躁吗？

drillParagraphs.question: What do we use sacks for?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use sacks for transporting and storing things like vegetables, especially potatoes
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们用麻袋做什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们使用麻袋来运输和储存蔬菜等物品，尤其是土豆

drillParagraphs.question: What does the expression "to get the sack" mean?
drillParagraphs.answer: The expression … to be dismissed from employment
drillParagraphs.questionZh: “被解雇”这句话是什么意思？

drillParagraphs.question: How would you react if you were unfairly fired from a job you liked, especially if there were mass unemployment at the time?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你被不公平地解雇了你喜欢的工作，特别是当时存在大规模失业，你会如何反应？

drillParagraphs.question: What's a deadline?
drillParagraphs.answer: A deadline is a time or date before which something has to be finished
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么是截止日期？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 截止日期是必须完成某件事的时间或日期

drillParagraphs.question: What can we say instead of "suddenly"?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 除了“突然”，我们还能说什么？

drillParagraphs.question: Why is it important to ensure that the air in a classroom doesn't become stale?
drillParagraphs.answer: It's … because stale air lacks oxygen, which is essential for the brain to work properly
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么确保教室里的空气不会变得浑浊很重要？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 这是……因为污浊的空气缺乏氧气，而氧气对于大脑的正常工作至关重要

drillParagraphs.question: What do we call the mark left on our skin after a wound has healed?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 伤口愈合后皮肤上留下的痕迹叫什么？

drillParagraphs.question: How can parents prevent their young children from getting at medicine bottles or containers with chemicals in them?
drillParagraphs.answer: Parents can … by storing them on high shelves, or in locked cupboards
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 父母如何防止年幼的孩子接触装有化学品的药瓶或容器？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 父母可以……将它们存放在高架子上或上锁的橱柜中

drillParagraphs.question: Do your parents have any grandchildren?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, my parents have a grandson, granddaughter etc. ~ No, my parents don't have any grandchildren
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你的父母有孙子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，我的父母有孙子，孙女等〜不，我的父母没有孙子

drillParagraphs.question: If someone feels constantly depressed, can their doctor prescribe medicine to help relieve the depression?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果有人持续感到抑郁，医生可以开药来帮助缓解抑郁吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Why do people's minds sometimes go blank when they're trying to answer a question in a job interview?
drillParagraphs.answer: People's minds … because they feel stressed
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么人们在求职面试中试图回答问题时有时会脑子一片空白？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 人们的思想……因为他们感到压力

drillParagraphs.question: Do you believe in the saying "Never put off until tomorrow that which you can do today"?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你相信“今天能做的事永远不要推迟到明天”这句话吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Would you be put off going to a restaurant with a good reputation if a friend told you they'd recently had an awful meal there?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果朋友告诉你他们最近在那里吃了一顿糟糕的饭，你会推迟去一家声誉良好的餐厅吗？

drillParagraphs.question: When buying an expensive painting or other work of art, how can you assure yourself that it is genuine and not a fake?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, … by asking to see a certificate, getting a second opinion from an expert etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当购买昂贵的绘画或其他艺术品时，您如何确保它是真品而不是赝品？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……，……通过要求查看证书、获得专家的第二意见等。

drillParagraphs.question: Of course I don't approve/ of misbehaviour,/ but I can't monitor my children/ all the time,/ and it'd be unnatural/ if they never did anything wrong,/ wouldn't it?/ The?
drillParagraphs.answer: sailor's refusal/ to associate himself with the plan/ to cross the channel at night/ had been expected;/ it was hardly logical./ Walking into court,/ Pete felt both scared and embarrassed./ A climber's chief concern/ is always the quality/ of his equipment./ She has superior knowledge/ of the subject/ and we definitely aim/ to take advantage of that./ The primary reason/ for baby pigeons/ being such a rare sight/ is that they tend to remain in the nest/ for such a long time./ Image, slide, rude, click, anyway.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当然我不赞成/不当行为，/但我不能/一直监视我的孩子，/如果他们从来没有做错任何事，那将是不自然的，/不是吗？/？

drillParagraphs.question: In a major sporting competition such as the Olympics, do you think it's important for everyone participating to believe they stand a chance of winning?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, in a … ~ No, in a … sell out

drillParagraphs.answer: When I go …, I feel disappointed and frustrated

drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我去……时，我感到失望和沮丧

drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么有人需要在休息日打电话到他们的办公室？

drillParagraphs.question: What do parents mean when they say their son or daughter is going through a difficult phase?
drillParagraphs.answer: When parents …, they mean their son or daughter is going through a temporary period of rebelling against them, and is difficult to cope with, perhaps because they're being grumpy and stubborn
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当父母说他们的儿子或女儿正在经历困难阶段时，他们的意思是什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当父母......时，他们的意思是他们的儿子或女儿正在经历一段暂时的反抗他们的时期，并且难以应对，也许是因为他们脾气暴躁和顽固

drillParagraphs.question: Do some university students find it hard to cope if they have to do a part-time job on top of studying for their degree?

drillParagraphs.answerZh: 真空吸尘器的工作原理是通过管子将污垢吸到容器中

drillParagraphs.answer: We buy jam, honey, coffee etc. in jars

drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们买罐装的果酱、蜂蜜、咖啡等

drillParagraphs.answer: By …, we mean someone who is difficult to please as regards food because there are many things they don't like eating
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们所说的挑食是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们所说的……是指在食物方面难以取悦的人，因为有很多东西他们不喜欢吃

drillParagraphs.question: What's generally the difference between the words "district" and "region"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The difference … is that "district" is generally used to describe a distinct part of a city for official reasons, whereas "region" is generally used to describe a distinct part of a larger area such as a country, continent, or even the world

drillParagraphs.question: Why?

drillParagraphs.question: What's the danger of regularly listening to music at high volume on earphones or headphones?
drillParagraphs.answer: The danger … is that one can damage one's hearing
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 经常用耳机或头戴式耳机大音量听音乐有什么危险？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 危险……是可能会损害听力

drillParagraphs.question: If you give someone your opinion on something and they say "I agree with you to an extent", what do they mean?
drillParagraphs.answer: If I …, they mean they agree with me partly but not completely
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你向某人提出对某事的看法，而他们说“我在某种程度上同意你的观点”，这是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果我……，他们的意思是他们部分同意我的观点，但不完全同意

drillParagraphs.question: Is your mood dictated by the weather to some extent?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, my mood's … to some extent ~ No, my mood isn't … at all
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你的心情在某种程度上受天气影响吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，我的心情……在某种程度上〜不，我的心情根本不是……

drillParagraphs.question: What do you eat when you need a quick energy boost between meals?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当您需要在两餐之间快速补充能量时，您会吃什么？

drillParagraphs.question: Is there a strong sense of community among the residents of the area where you live?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您居住地区的居民是否有强烈的社区意识？

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean by folk music?
drillParagraphs.answer: By …, we mean the traditional music of a particular community
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们所说的民间音乐是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们所说的……是指特定社区的传统音乐

drillParagraphs.question: What are the three forms of "weep"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The three forms of "weep" are "weep, wept, wept"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: “哭”有哪三种形式？

drillParagraphs.question: Do people often weep at the funeral of someone they were very close to?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 人们经常在他们非常亲近的人的葬礼上哭泣吗？

drillParagraphs.question: 12 Do you have enough money to … the cost of all the repairs your car needs?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 12 您有足够的钱来……支付您的汽车所需的所有维修费用吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you usually wake up in a cheerful mood?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您通常以愉快的心情醒来吗？

drillParagraphs.question: What might happen to a building if it doesn't have decent foundations?
drillParagraphs.answer: If a building …, it might start sinking into the land, and could eventually collapse
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果建筑物没有良好的地基，会发生什么情况？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果一座建筑物......，它可能会开始下沉到土地中，并最终可能倒塌

drillParagraphs.question: What's a lounge?
drillParagraphs.answer: A lounge is a large room in a private house, a hotel, an airport terminal etc. where people can sit and relax
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么是休息室？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 休息室是私人住宅、酒店、机场航站楼等的一个大房间，人们可以坐下来放松

drillParagraphs.question: What two other names are commonly used for a lounge in a private house?
drillParagraphs.answer: Two other names … "sitting room" and "living room"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 私人住宅的休息室通常使用哪两个名称？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 另外两个名字……“客厅”和“客厅”

drillParagraphs.question: What am I doing?
drillParagraphs.answer: You're glancing at your watch, the picture on the wall etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我在做什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 你正在看手表、墙上的照片等。

drillParagraphs.question: What do I mean if I say "I glimpsed the stadium in the distance several times as I drove through the town"?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, you mean you briefly saw the stadium several times
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我说“当我开车穿过城镇时，我多次瞥见远处的体育场”是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，您的意思是您多次短暂地参观了体育场

drillParagraphs.question: If you visited India, would it be reasonable to assume that, before long, you'd catch a glimpse of a tiger?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果您访问过印度，是否可以合理地假设不久之后您就会看到老虎？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you always keep a pen handy in case you need one?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否总是随身携带一支笔以备不时之需？

drillParagraphs.question: At major public events such as music festivals, are there always ambulances on hand to deal with medical emergencies?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在音乐节等重大公共活动中，是否总有救护车随时待命以应对医疗紧急情况？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you believe it's better to dispose of old junk rather than keep stuff in case it comes in handy one day?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, I believe … ~ No, I don't believe …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否认为处理掉旧垃圾比保留东西以备将来派上用场更好？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，我相信……～不，我不相信……

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean by junk email, or spam?
drillParagraphs.answer: By …, we mean unwanted email that is sent to a huge number of people
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 垃圾邮件或垃圾邮件是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们所说的……是指发送给大量人员的不需要的电子邮件

drillParagraphs.question: Who's your favourite contemporary author?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您最喜欢的当代作家是谁？

drillParagraphs.question: How are satellites launched into space?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 卫星是如何发射到太空的？

drillParagraphs.question: Why do some people buy products, especially technological products, as soon as they're launched rather than wait a while for prices to come down?
drillParagraphs.answer: Some people … because they're excited by the product and can't wait to get one of their own
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么有些人会在产品特别是科技产品推出后立即购买，而不是等待价格下降一段时间？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 有些人……因为他们对产品感到兴奋，迫不及待地想拥有一款属于自己的产品

drillParagraphs.question: What happens if a person's spending constantly exceeds their earnings?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, they go overdrawn at the bank
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果一个人的支出持续超过收入，会发生什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，他们就会在银行透支

drillParagraphs.question: Is it fairly normal for university students in your country to end up with large overdrafts?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在你们国家，大学生出现大额透支是很正常的吗？

drillParagraphs.question: What's a sketch?
drillParagraphs.answer: A sketch is a quick drawing that shows the rough outline of something and just a few details
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么是草图？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 草图是一种快速绘图，显示某物的粗略轮廓和一些细节

drillParagraphs.question: Who in your life would you say had inspired you more than anyone else?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在你的一生中，你认为谁对你的启发最大？

drillParagraphs.question: Is there anywhere in this country where tourism is vital for the welfare of?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 这个国家有哪些地方旅游业对民众的福祉至关重要？

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean if we describe someone as insecure?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, we mean that the person doesn't have much self-confidence and worries too much
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我们形容某人没有安全感，这意味着什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，我们的意思是这个人没有太多的自信并且担心太多

drillParagraphs.question: If you wanted maximum security for your money, would you rather set up a pension, invest in the stock market, or save the money in a bank account?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果您希望资金得到最大程度的保障，您愿意设立养老金、投资股票市场还是将钱存入银行账户？

drillParagraphs.question: When the police arrest a criminal, what do they use to secure the person's wrists together?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当警察逮捕罪犯时，他们用什么来将人的手腕固定在一起？

drillParagraphs.question: Is it still important to learn proper typing technique if you want to work as a secretary these days?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你现在想当秘书，学习正确的打字技术还重要吗？

drillParagraphs.question: What are two other common names we can use instead of "pullover"?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 除了“pullover”之外，我们还可以使用哪两个常用名称？

drillParagraphs.question: Is there any difference between a professor and a lecturer?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 教授和讲师有什么区别吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Would you say you were good at giving people directions?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你会说你很擅长给人们指路吗？

drillParagraphs.question: If I drove from here to the nearest station, how many turnings would I have to make?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我从这里开车到最近的车站，需要转多少个弯？

drillParagraphs.question: When on holiday, do you enjoy getting together with other tourists to go on organized excursions?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 假期时，您喜欢与其他游客一起进行有组织的游览吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Which would you enjoy more this evening: a large party at a public venue, or a small get-together at someone's house?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 今晚您更喜欢哪一个：公共场所的大型聚会，还是某人家里的小型聚会？

drillParagraphs.question: What is meant when someone shouts "Look out!" or "Watch out!"?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, they mean "Be careful", usually because something dangerous is about to happen
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当有人大喊“小心！”时，这意味着什么？或“小心！”？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: When …，他们的意思是“小心”，通常是因为危险的事情即将发生

drillParagraphs.question: What happens when there's a security alert at a railway station or an airport?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, all services are disrupted or have to be suspended until the alert is over
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当火车站或机场出现安全警报时会发生什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……时，所有服务都会中断或必须暂停，直到警报结束

drillParagraphs.question: Do you enjoy listening to and reading gossip?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你喜欢听和读八卦吗？

drillParagraphs.question: When you eventually retire from work, what kind of hobbies do you think you might pursue to help fill your extra leisure time?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, I think I might pursue hobbies such as … to help fill …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当您最终退休时，您认为您可能会追求什么样的爱好来帮助填补额外的闲暇时间？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当......时，我想我可能会追求诸如......之类的爱好来帮助填补......

drillParagraphs.question: When police officers are pursuing a suspect, why do they turn on the siren in their car?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, they turn … to warn other drivers to be careful etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 警察在追捕嫌疑人时，为什么要打开车内的警报器？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……时，他们转向……警告其他司机要小心等等。

drillParagraphs.question: Which disability do you imagine has the biggest impact on a person's life: being deaf or being blind?
drillParagraphs.answer: The disability that I imagine has … Why?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为哪种残疾对一个人的生活影响最大：聋还是盲？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我想象中的残疾……为什么？

drillParagraphs.question: How do we usually start an informal letter or email?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们通常如何开始一封非正式的信件或电子邮件？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们通常开始......“亲爱的（名字）”或“嗨（名字）”

drillParagraphs.question: Should we use contractions in this kind of writing?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在这种写作中我们应该使用缩写吗？

drillParagraphs.question: And how can we finish such a letter or email?
drillParagraphs.answer: We can finish … "Best wishes", "Love", "Bye for now" etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们怎样才能完成这样的一封信或电子邮件呢？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们可以完成……“最美好的祝愿”、“爱”、“再见”等。

drillParagraphs.question: Before leaving on a holiday or long flight, do you look around the airport bookshop or newsagent's to see what novels and magazines are on sale?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在出发度假或长途飞行之前，您是否会逛逛机场书店或报刊亭，看看有哪些小说和杂志在打折？

drillParagraphs.question: Why do some people prefer not to transfer money from one country to another via the internet?
drillParagraphs.answer: Some … because they feel it isn't adequately secure
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么有些人不愿意通过互联网将钱从一个国家转移到另一个国家？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 有些……因为他们觉得不够安全

drillParagraphs.question: Are there many countries whose citizens can gain entry to this country without the need for a visa?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 是否有许多国家/地区的公民无需签证即可进入该国家/地区？

drillParagraphs.question: Were many countries around the world at war with one another between 1939 and 1945?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 1939 年至 1945 年间，世界上有许多国家彼此交战吗？

drillParagraphs.question: If a friend of yours, who you knew was a dreadful driver, offered to give you a lift, what would you do?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你的一个朋友，你知道他是个糟糕的司机，愿意载你一程，你会怎么做？

drillParagraphs.question: In your opinion, are the clothes I'm wearing appropriate for the weather we're having today?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你认为我穿的衣服适合今天的天气吗？

drillParagraphs.question: If you weren't enjoying a play at the theatre, why would it be more appropriate to leave during an interval than during the performance itself?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, it'd be more … because leaving during the performance might well distract members of the audience, and even the cast

drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……那就更……因为演出期间离开很可能会分散观众甚至演员的注意力

drillParagraphs.question: Does a train accelerate when it pulls into a station?
drillParagraphs.answer: No, a train doesn't …; it slows down and comes to a halt
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 火车进站时会加速吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 不，火车不……； it slows down and comes to a halt

drillParagraphs.question: Do you agree that sport provides an invaluable outlet for bored and restless teenagers who might otherwise get into trouble?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否同意体育运动为无聊和焦躁的青少年提供了一个宝贵的出路，否则他们可能会陷入麻烦？

drillParagraphs.question: Which person in the world today impresses you the most, and what do you find so impressive about them?

drillParagraphs.question: When considering the cost of repairs to a car, why should you always ask the mechanic to give you a quote rather than an estimate?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, … because a quote tells you the actual cost of the repairs, whereas an estimate is only approximate and the actual cost may be higher

drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……，……因为报价告诉您维修的实际成本，而估算只是近似值，实际成本可能更高

drillParagraphs.question: How do people feel when, after having been in danger for a time, they finally find themselves out of danger?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当人们在经历了一段时间的危险之后终于脱离了危险时，会有什么感觉？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……之后，人们感到如释重负。

drillParagraphs.question: Are your memories of early childhood mainly visual, or can you recollect actual conversations you had with people?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您对童年早期的记忆主要是视觉记忆，还是您能回忆起与人进行过的实际对话？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you visualize the world fifty years from now as being very different?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为五十年后的世界会变得非常不同吗？

drillParagraphs.question: If a drain outside your house was blocked, what would you do?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你家外面的下水道被堵住了，你会怎么做？

drillParagraphs.question: Has anyone in your family established their own company?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您家里有人创办过自己的公司吗？

drillParagraphs.question: And what do we call the part of a plane where the pilot sits?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 飞机上飞行员所坐的部分我们怎么称呼？

drillParagraphs.question: What kind of things are usually delivered by post?
drillParagraphs.answer: The kind … birthday cards, bills, small packages etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 通常通过邮寄方式递送哪些物品？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 种类……生日贺卡、账单、小包裹等。

drillParagraphs.question: When a manager gives an employee feedback on their performance at work, do you think they should always speak frankly or should they take into account the worker's character?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当经理向员工反馈他们的工作表现时，你认为他们应该总是坦诚地说话还是应该考虑员工的性格？

drillParagraphs.question: If one family member goes down with flu, are other members of the household liable to catch it as well?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果一名家庭成员患上流感，其他家庭成员是否也容易感染流感？

drillParagraphs.question: When you're at work, who's liable for your safety?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, my employer is … display show off
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当你工作时，谁对你的安全负责？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you believe there's any difference in the way men and women display their emotions?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你认为男人和女人表达情感的方式有什么不同吗？

drillParagraphs.question: What do you think the difference is, then?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 那你觉得有什么区别呢？

drillParagraphs.question: Did your primary school used to show off its pupils' work to visitors by creating displays around the building?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您的小学过去是否通过在建筑物周围展示来向游客展示学生的作品？

drillParagraphs.question: Why do you suppose people, especially children, show off?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你认为人们，尤其是孩子，为什么会炫耀？

drillParagraphs.question: What's the most expensive article of clothing you have on at the moment?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你现在穿的最贵的衣服是什么？

drillParagraphs.question: When you first started at this school, did you have any prior knowledge of the Callan Method?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当您第一次进入这所学校时，您对卡兰方法有任何了解吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Prior to the use of computers in industry, was factory output generally lower?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在工业使用计算机之前，工厂产出普遍较低吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Which is a higher priority for you: having plenty of spare time or having plenty of money?
drillParagraphs.answer: Having … is a higher priority for me than …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 对你来说，哪一个更重要：有充足的业余时间还是有足够的钱？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 对我来说，拥有……比……更重要

drillParagraphs.question: Is it common for a person to have a scientific mind but also possess great artistic talent?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 一个人既有科学头脑，又有出色的艺术才华，这很常见吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Would you say one needed scientific skills to be an inventor?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, I'd say … ~ No, I wouldn't say …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为一个人需要科学技能才能成为发明家吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，我会说……〜不，我不会说……

drillParagraphs.question: If a series of similar crimes occurred in one area within a short period, what might the police assume?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, the police might assume that just one person was responsible for the crimes
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果短时间内在一个地区发生一系列类似的犯罪行为，警方会做出怎样的判断？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果......，警方可能会认为只有一个人对这些犯罪负责

drillParagraphs.question: What do we call each individual programme that a TV series is composed of?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们如何称呼电视剧组成的每个单独的节目？

drillParagraphs.question: If a cat's territory was invaded by a fox, do you think the cat would be more liable to fight the fox or run away?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果一只猫的领地被狐狸入侵，你认为猫会更容易与狐狸战斗还是逃跑？

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean by a cover letter?
drillParagraphs.answer: By …, we mean a formal letter that we send along with our CV when we apply for a job
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 求职信是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们所说的……是指我们在申请工作时随简历一起发送的一封正式信函

drillParagraphs.question: When writing an application letter or email to someone called "David Jones", for example, how should we start the letter: "Dear David", "Dear David Jones" or "Dear Mr Jones"?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 例如，当给一个叫“大卫琼斯”的人写求职信或电子邮件时，我们应该如何开始这封信：“亲爱的大卫”，“亲爱的大卫琼斯”或“亲爱的琼斯先生”？

drillParagraphs.question: How can we start the letter if we don't know the person's name?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我们不知道对方的名字，我们该如何开始这封信呢？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，……用“亲爱的先生或女士”

drillParagraphs.question: In the main paragraphs of the letter, how can we persuade the reader to consider our application?
drillParagraphs.answer: In …, … by highlighting and summarizing any particularly relevant experience and skills from our CV, and by showing enthusiasm for the company and job
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在信的主要段落中，我们如何说服读者考虑我们的申请？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 在……，……通过强调和总结我们简历中任何特别相关的经验和技能，并表现出对公司和工作的热情

drillParagraphs.question: What else can we do?
drillParagraphs.answer: We can mention any relevant abilities and personal qualities we have
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们还能做什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们可以提及我们拥有的任何相关能力和个人品质

drillParagraphs.question: How should we conclude the letter?
drillParagraphs.answer: We … by thanking the company for considering our application, and mentioning our availability for interview
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们该如何结束这封信呢？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们……感谢公司考虑我们的申请，并提及我们可以接受面试

drillParagraphs.question: If we've used a name at the start of the letter, how should we finish it?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我们在信的开头使用了名字，我们应该如何结束它？

drillParagraphs.question: And how should we finish if we haven't used a name at the start?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我们一开始就没有使用名字，我们应该如何结束呢？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you agree that mobile phone use on trains should be restricted to a limited number of coaches?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否同意火车上使用手机应仅限于有限数量的车厢？

drillParagraphs.question: And if such a regulation were established, do you think most people would comply with it?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果制定了这样的规定，您认为大多数人会遵守吗？

drillParagraphs.question: When do people usually frown?
drillParagraphs.answer: People … when they feel annoyed, when they're confused, or when they're concentrating hard
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 人们通常什么时候皱眉？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 人们……当他们感到烦恼时、当他们感到困惑时、或者当他们努力集中注意力时

drillParagraphs.question: If you'd finished using a barbecue but the fire was still glowing, would you put it out with water, for example, or wait for it to go out on its own?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 例如，如果您使用完烧烤炉但火仍然在燃烧，您会用水将其扑灭，还是等待它自行熄灭？

drillParagraphs.question: If a boxer manages to knock his opponent down easily in both the first and second round, can he reasonably expect to be able to knock him out fairly soon after?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果一名拳击手在第一轮和第二轮中都能轻松击倒对手，他是否可以合理地期望很快就能将对手击倒？

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean by a knockout competition?
drillParagraphs.answer: By a knockout competition, we mean one that consists of different rounds, and where only the winner of each match goes through to the next round
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 淘汰赛是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们所说的淘汰赛是指由不同轮次组成的比赛，只有每场比赛的获胜者才能进入下一轮

drillParagraphs.question: Why do some lorries have "long vehicle" written on their rear ends?
drillParagraphs.answer: Some lorries … to indicate to the vehicles coming behind that it will be difficult to overtake
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么有些卡车的尾部写着“长车”？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 一些卡车……向后面的车辆表明很难超车

drillParagraphs.question: Would you say learning to cook was merely a matter of following recipes?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你会说学习做饭只是遵循菜谱的问题吗？

drillParagraphs.question: How do we spell the word "principal" in the following sentence: "The principal melody in this piece of music is known all around the world"?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们如何拼写下面这句话中的“主要”一词：“这首音乐的主旋律全世界都知道”？

drillParagraphs.question: How do we spell the word "principle" in the following sentence: "My basic principle in life is to treat everybody with respect"?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们如何拼写以下句子中的“原则”一词：“我生活中的基本原则是尊重每个人”？

drillParagraphs.question: What do we call a woman and man on their wedding day?
drillParagraphs.answer: We call … the bride and groom (bridegroom)
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 女人和男人在结婚当天怎么称呼？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们称……新娘和新郎（新郎）

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean by a site?
drillParagraphs.answer: By a site, we mean the place where
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们所说的网站是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们所说的站点是指该地方

drillParagraphs.question: Do some large office buildings have restaurants on site?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 一些大型办公楼内是否设有餐厅？

drillParagraphs.question: What else is the word "site" used to refer to?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: “站点”一词还可以用来指代什么？

drillParagraphs.question: When people find something hilarious, what do they do?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当人们发现一些有趣的事情时，他们会做什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……的时候，他们突然大笑起来

drillParagraphs.question: What's a survey?
drillParagraphs.answer: A survey is a form of research that involves asking many people questions in order to discover facts or opinions
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么是调查？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 调查是一种研究形式，涉及向许多人提出问题以发现事实或观点

drillParagraphs.question: Why is it crucial for companies to carry out customer surveys?
drillParagraphs.answer: It's crucial … as it provides them with important information for new or existing projects, such as the development of products and services
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么开展客户调查对于公司至关重要？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 这至关重要……因为它为他们提供了新项目或现有项目的重要信息，例如产品和服务的开发

drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我名字的首字母是 M.F.R. （马里奥·弗兰科·罗西）

drillParagraphs.question: What's the average student's initial reaction to the Callan Method?
drillParagraphs.answer: The average … is to be amazed by the speed of the lessons
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 一般学生对卡兰方法的最初反应是什么？

drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当谈到考试时，您是否能够很好地应对，或者紧张和压力是否会影响您的表现？

drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么样的音乐让你疯狂？

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean if we describe someone as odd?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, we mean they are strange
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我们形容某人很奇怪，这意味着什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，我们的意思是他们很奇怪

drillParagraphs.question: If you were watching a procession in the street and a policeman told you to get back, what would he want you to do and why?
drillParagraphs.answer: If I were …, he'd want me to move away from the procession, probably because I was standing dangerously close
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你在街上观看游行，警察让你回去，他会希望你做什么，为什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果我……，他会希望我离开游行队伍，可能是因为我站得太近了，很危险

drillParagraphs.question: If you left home at 4 o'clock and were away for an hour, at what time would you get back?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你四点钟出门，离开家一个小时，你什么时候回来？

drillParagraphs.question: In what ways has the introduction of digital cameras made photography easier?
drillParagraphs.answer: The introduction … photography is cheaper, photos are easier to edit etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 数码相机的引入在哪些方面使摄影变得更加容易？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 简介……摄影更便宜，照片更容易编辑等等。

drillParagraphs.question: Name something most people eat that's high in carbohydrates?
drillParagraphs.answer: The name … bread (or rice, potatoes, pasta etc.)
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 说出大多数人吃的碳水化合物含量高的东西？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 名称……面包（或米饭、土豆、面食等）

drillParagraphs.question: Why does the idea of being a passenger on a motorbike tend to scare people more than the idea of travelling in a car?
drillParagraphs.answer: The idea of … because motorbike passengers are exposed and more liable to get injured in an accident than passengers in a car
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么骑摩托车的乘客比乘坐汽车旅行的想法更让人害怕？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 这个想法……因为摩托车乘客比汽车乘客更容易在事故中受伤

drillParagraphs.question: What do I mean if I say "The Prime Minister's secret was exposed in the press"?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, you mean that the newspapers published a story revealing information that the Prime Minister had wanted to keep secret
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我说“首相的秘密被媒体曝光”是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，你的意思是报纸发表了一篇报道，揭露了总理想要保密的信息

drillParagraphs.question: When you're on your way to meet someone but only have a vague idea of where you're going, what do you do?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, I ask someone for directions, use the internet etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当你在去见某人的路上，但对要去哪里只有一个模糊的概念时，你会怎么做？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当......时，我向某人问路，使用互联网等。

drillParagraphs.question: What does the verb "to spot" mean?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 动词“发现”是什么意思？

drillParagraphs.question: If you spotted a tiny stain on the front of a friend's wedding dress a few hours before the ceremony itself, would you bring the matter up or just keep quiet?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果您在仪式开始前几个小时发现朋友的婚纱正面有一个微小的污渍，您会提出这个问题还是保持沉默？

drillParagraphs.question: What do we call the inside and outside of a building or vehicle, for example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We … the interior and the exterior
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 例如，我们如何称呼建筑物或车辆的内部和外部？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you think your parents spent a lot of money on decorating the interior of the home you grew up in?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你认为你的父母花了很多钱来装饰你长大的房子的内部吗？

drillParagraphs.question: What sort of sporting events have worldwide appeal?
drillParagraphs.answer: The sort of … the Olympic Games, the World Cup etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么样的体育赛事具有全球吸引力？

drillParagraphs.question: Who do you usually appeal to when you need help desperately?
drillParagraphs.answer: When I …, I usually appeal to my parents, a close friend of mine etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当你迫切需要帮助时，你通常会向谁求助？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我……时，我通常会向我的父母、我的密友等求助。

drillParagraphs.question: Why do international broadcasting corporations such as the BBC avoid using people with very strong regional accents to announce the news?
drillParagraphs.answer: International corporations such as … because people around the world might have trouble understanding them
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么英国广播公司（BBC）等国际广播公司避免使用带有浓重地方口音的人来宣布新闻？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 国际公司，例如……因为世界各地的人们可能难以理解它们

drillParagraphs.question: If two of your friends start arguing, do you think it's always best to remain neutral?
drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, if …, I think … ~ No, if …, I don't think …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你的两个朋友开始争吵，你认为保持中立总是最好的吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，如果……，我认为……〜不，如果……，我不认为……

drillParagraphs.question: Which gear should a driver be in when stationary at traffic lights?
drillParagraphs.answer: A driver should be in neutral when …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 驾驶员在红绿灯处停车时应挂哪个档位？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……时，驾驶员应保持空挡。

drillParagraphs.question: Which pedal do we have to put our foot on when we change gear in a car?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当我们开车换挡时，我们应该踩哪个踏板？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you prefer doing physical exercise outside as opposed to in a gym?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 与在健身房相比，您更喜欢在户外进行体育锻炼吗？

drillParagraphs.question: There'll be little sorrow/ at the king's departure./ Am I going deaf/ or is our teacher quiet?/ It's almost like he's whispering sometimes!/ A war journalist needs to be/?
drillParagraphs.answer: both curious and courageous./ Whatever you do,/ don't spill that ink;/ it'd leave a terrible stain/ on the carpet./ I'm keen to sell this fruit/ as quickly as possible./ It's already looking/ a bit overripe,/ and we've got tons of it left./ The actual concert venue/ doesn't open till eight,/ so, meanwhile,/ why don't we enjoy/ the warmth of that bar?/ The film was ruined for her/ owing to the constant sound of sneezing/ from the row behind her./ Swallow, patience, cushion, decay, coward.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 国王离开时/不会有什么悲伤。/我会聋吗/还是我们的老师很安静？/有时就像他在窃窃私语！/战地记者需要/？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 既好奇又勇敢。/无论你做什么，/不要把墨水洒出来；/它会在地毯上留下可怕的污渍。/我很想/尽快卖掉这种水果。/它看起来已经/有点熟透了，/我们还剩下很多。/实际的音乐会场地/要到八点才开放，/所以，与此同时，/我们为什么不享受/那个酒吧的温暖？/这部电影对她来说毁了/因为持续不断的声音打喷嚏/从她后面的一排传来。/吞咽，耐心，缓冲，腐烂，胆小鬼。

vocabulary.meaningEn: A watchword or rallying cry, a verbal signal (even when consisting of multiple words).
A vessel for boiling a liquid or cooking food, usually metal and equipped with a lid.
A mechanical device for awaking people, or rousing their attention.
A line or crease in the skin, especially when caused by age or fatigue.
To join or attach something using glue.
A type of pre-formed packaging made from plastic that contains cavities.
A covering for the head attached to a larger garment such as a jacket or cloak.
A small cafeteria or snack bar, especially one in a military establishment, school, or place of work.
To stew in an earthenware jug etc.
A small ticket or sign giving information about something to which it is attached or intended to be attached.
The part of the palm of a hand closest to the wrist.
To anger or annoy.
A bizarre or whimsical creature.
Any of various insects in the family Formicidae in the order Hymenoptera, typically living in large colonies composed almost entirely of flightless females.
A traveling company of performers that may include acrobats, clowns, trained animals, and other novelty acts, that gives shows usually in a circular tent.
To assist (sheep) to give birth.
A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
A body of text meant to be read line by line, especially in printed material that has multiple adjacent such on a single page.
Something resembling such a structure.
The art and science of designing and managing the construction of buildings and other structures, particularly if they are well proportioned and decorated.
A professional who designs buildings or other structures, or who prepares plans and superintends construction.
The act of combining, the state of being combined or the result of combining.

To leave behind; to desert as in a ship or a position, typically in response to overwhelming odds or impending dangers; to forsake, in spite of a duty or responsibility.
To give something that is or becomes part of a larger whole.

Advertising or other activity designed to rouse public interest in something.
The thing or property granted; a gift; a boon.
To be the setting or time of.
To fail to hit.
A person who is intentionally, physically, or emotionally cruel to others; especially to those who are weaker or have less power or privilege.
The blow that drives the shuttle, used in calculating the speed of a loom (in picks per minute); hence, in describing the fineness of a fabric, a weft thread.
A defensive position or effort.
A token; a sign; a symptom or indication.
A performing engagement by a musical group; or, generally, any job or role, especially for a musician or performer.

To engage by feeling or sentiment; to interest.
To end; to come to an end.
To provide someone with an incentive to do something; to encourage.

A contract to sell a security at a set price on or before a certain date.

In one way or another; in a way not yet known or explained; by some means

The result of a contest that neither side has won; a tie.

To change (something) from a smaller form and/or size to a larger one; to spread out or lay open.

The person, place or thing from which something (information, goods, etc.) comes or is acquired.
A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
An upright open container used mainly for displaying fresh, dried, or artificial flowers.
The maximum amount that can be held
To subject to analysis.
Decomposition into components in order to study (a complex thing, concept, theory etc.).
An insult.
A sudden percussive noise.
A place or institution for the confinement of persons held in lawful custody or detention, especially for minor offenses or with reference to some future judicial proceeding.
To fill with horror; to dismay.
A wide and unconstrained variety.
An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.
To enter into; to make way into the interior of; to pierce.
A rejection letter, as for employment, admission to a school or a competition.
To make resistant to failure.
To make resistant to transmitting sound.
To continue unchanged in place, form, or condition, or undiminished in quantity; to abide; to stay; to endure; to last.
Material used as bedding for animals.
A systematic plan of future action.
Meaning of the word word-building exercise.

drillParagraphs.question: In reference to architecture, what do we mean by a column or pillar?
drillParagraphs.answer: In reference …, … a vertical post, usually made of stone, that supports part of a building
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在建筑学中，柱子是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 在参考文献中……，……通常由石头制成的垂直柱子，支撑建筑物的一部分

drillParagraphs.question: Does the work of an architect involve a combination of artistic and scientific skills?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 建筑师的工作是否涉及艺术和科学技能的结合？

drillParagraphs.question: Have you ever been asked to write a column for a college magazine or a local newspaper?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否曾被要求为大学杂志或当地报纸撰写专栏？

drillParagraphs.question: Is it easier to add up a series of numbers if they're arranged in a row or a column?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果将一系列数字排列成行或列，那么将它们相加会更容易吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Do local councils sometimes have to abandon projects owing to insufficient funds?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 地方议会有时会因为资金不足而不得不放弃项目吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Why might a business contribute funds towards a local community project such as the building of playground facilities for children?
drillParagraphs.answer: A business might … because the owner wants to help …, it's good publicity etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么企业可以为当地社区项目（例如为儿童建造游乐场设施）捐款？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 企业可能……因为业主想提供帮助……，这是很好的宣传等等。

drillParagraphs.question: If you could have any wish granted, what would it be?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你可以实现任何一个愿望，你会是什么？

drillParagraphs.question: Does the government of your country give grants to university students?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 贵国政府向大学生提供助学金吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Why is it often quite easy to see through a lie told by a small child?
drillParagraphs.answer: It's … obvious from the child's face …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么小孩子的谎言往往很容易被识破？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 这……从孩子的脸上就可以看出来……

drillParagraphs.question: If you bought a jigsaw puzzle but then discovered a piece was missing, what would you do?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你买了一个拼图游戏，但发现少了一块，你会怎么做？

drillParagraphs.question: Did you often witness instances of bullying at your secondary school?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否经常在中学目睹欺凌事件？

drillParagraphs.question: If a ten-year-old boy revealed to you that a bully was picking on him at school, would you advise him to stand up for himself or tell him to report the bully to a teacher?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果一个十岁的男孩向你透露学校里有一个欺凌者欺负他，你会建议他为自己辩护还是让他向老师举报欺凌行为？

drillParagraphs.question: What was the last gig you went to?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你上次去参加的演出是什么？

drillParagraphs.question: Where's a good place to find out about upcoming (forthcoming) gigs in this town?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 哪里是了解这个镇即将举行的演出的好地方？

drillParagraphs.question: Why do we keep garden tools in a shed rather than in the house?
drillParagraphs.answer: We … they're easier to access, they're too dirty to keep in the house etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么我们把园艺工具放在棚子里而不是放在房子里？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们……它们更容易接近，它们太脏而不能放在家里等等。

drillParagraphs.question: During a criminal investigation, can the police demand access to a suspect's personal records such as bank statements and email history?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在刑事调查过程中，警方是否可以要求查阅嫌疑人的个人记录，例如银行对账单和电子邮件历史记录？

drillParagraphs.question: When giving someone feedback concerning their performance at work, why is it a good idea for a manager to conclude with a positive remark?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, it's a good idea … because it leaves the person feeling motivated to perform even better
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当向某人提供有关其工作表现的反馈时，为什么经理最好以积极的评价作为结束？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……时，这是一个好主意……因为它让人们有动力去表现得更好

drillParagraphs.question: Do you tend to put the TV on as soon as you get home?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你是否倾向于一回到家就打开电视？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you turn out your bedroom light before you get into bed or only once?
drillParagraphs.answer: you're in bed? I turn out …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你上床睡觉前会关掉卧室的灯还是只关掉一次？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 你在床上吗？结果我发现……

drillParagraphs.question: When people eat too much and do too little exercise, what happens?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当人们吃得太多而运动太少时，会发生什么？

drillParagraphs.question: If you asked me for permission to leave the room and I replied "By all means", what would you understand?
drillParagraphs.answer: If I … and you …, I'd understand that it was absolutely fine for me to leave the room
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你请求我允许离开房间，而我回答“无论如何”，你会理解什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果我……和你……，我就会明白我离开房间绝对没问题

drillParagraphs.question: What am I doing?
drillParagraphs.answer: You're peering over your book at me
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我在做什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 你正透过书本凝视着我

drillParagraphs.question: Is a child's conduct different when they're with their peers as opposed to one of their teachers at school?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 孩子与同龄人相处时的行为与与学校老师相处时的行为是否有所不同？

drillParagraphs.question: What's the name of the room a scientist uses to conduct experiments?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 科学家用来进行实验的房间叫什么名字？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you imagine the job of interpreting during important international business meetings to be interesting?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为重要国际商务会议期间的口译工作有趣吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Why does a large orchestra need to have a conductor?
drillParagraphs.answer: A large orchestra … because the conductor helps them all to play in time and interpret the music in the same way
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么大型乐团需要指挥？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 一个大型管弦乐队……因为指挥帮助他们所有人及时演奏并以相同的方式诠释音乐

drillParagraphs.question: When a contract is drawn up, do both parties have to sign it?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 合同签订后，双方都必须签字吗？

drillParagraphs.question: When water freezes and turns into ice, does it expand or contract?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当水结冰并变成冰时，它会膨胀还是收缩？

drillParagraphs.question: What would I mean if I said "The car drew up outside the hotel"?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, you'd mean that the car stopped outside the hotel
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我说“汽车停在酒店外面”是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，你的意思是车停在酒店外面

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean when we describe something as being brand new?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, we mean it's completely new
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当我们描述某事物是全新的时，我们的意思是什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……时，我们的意思是它是全新的

drillParagraphs.question: In which country is the source of the Amazon River?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 亚马逊河的源头是哪个国家？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you think the internet is the principal source of information for most people?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为互联网是大多数人的主要信息来源吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you reckon an ancient Egyptian vase would still be of value to a museum even if it was in pieces?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为古埃及花瓶即使是碎片，对博物馆来说仍然具有价值吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Which sports stadium has the largest capacity in this country?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 这个国家容量最大的体育场是哪个？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you have any friends who tend to analyse social situations too much?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你身边有没有过度分析社交情境的朋友？

drillParagraphs.question: Why might a doctor decide to request a blood analysis for a patient?
drillParagraphs.answer: A doctor … because a blood analysis can provide valuable clues about what is wrong with the patient
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么医生会决定要求患者进行血液分析？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 医生……因为血液分析可以提供有关患者问题的宝贵线索

drillParagraphs.question: When someone slams a door, is there a loud bang?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当有人关门时，是否会发出巨响？

drillParagraphs.question: If the living conditions in a jail were appalling, what might the prisoners do?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, prisoners might start a riot or try to break out
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果监狱里的生活条件十分恶劣，囚犯们会做什么呢？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，囚犯可能会引发骚乱或试图越狱

drillParagraphs.question: What do we mean when we say a room is soundproof or a window is bulletproof?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, we mean that sound can't penetrate through the walls of the room, or that a bullet could not penetrate the glass of the window
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当我们说房间隔音或窗户防弹时，我们是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……时，我们的意思是声音无法穿透房间的墙壁，或者子弹无法穿透窗户的玻璃

drillParagraphs.question: If you were on an excursion to see the remains of an ancient castle and you spotted another tourist dropping litter on the site, what would you do?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果您正在游览一座古城堡的遗迹，并且发现另一位游客在遗址上乱扔垃圾，您会怎么做？

drillParagraphs.question: How would you react if the government announced a scheme to build a new prison in your local area?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果政府宣布计划在您所在地区建造一座新监狱，您会有何反应？

drillParagraphs.question: In reference to driving, what's the difference between "pull up" and "pull over"?
drillParagraphs.answer: In reference …, the difference rag "pull up" simply means "stop", whereas "pull over" means "move to the side of the road and then stop"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在驾驶方面，“pull up”和“pull over”有什么区别？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 在参考文献中，差异“拉格”“pull up”仅表示“停止”，而“pull over”表示“移到路边然后停止”

drillParagraphs.question: Who's the most humorous person you know?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你认识的最幽默的人是谁？

drillParagraphs.question: What do you think is the key to a successful friendship?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你认为成功的友谊的关键是什么？

drillParagraphs.question: When the police are looking into a murder, why are fingerprints found at the scene of the crime often key to the success of the investigation?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, fingerprints … because no two people have the same fingerprints, which means they can be used as evidence that someone was present at the scene of a crime
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当警方调查谋杀案时，为什么在犯罪现场发现的指纹往往是调查成功的关键？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当……，指纹……因为没有两个人有相同的指纹，这意味着它们可以用作犯罪现场有人在场的证据

drillParagraphs.question: Why is it advisable in the home to keep fragile objects like china vases out of reach of small children?
drillParagraphs.answer: It is advisable … they might knock them over and smash them
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么建议在家中将瓷器花瓶等易碎物品放在儿童接触不到的地方？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 这是明智的……他们可能会把它们撞倒并砸碎

drillParagraphs.question: What's the opposite of "out of reach"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The opposite of … in reach, or within reach
drillParagraphs.questionZh: “遥不可及”的反义词是什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 与……相反，触手可及，或触手可及

drillParagraphs.question: What's the best way to recover from an illness?
drillParagraphs.answer: The best … is to relax, not strain oneself in any way, take some mild exercise etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 从疾病中恢复的最佳方法是什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 最好的……就是放松，不要以任何方式使自己紧张，进行一些轻微的运动等。

drillParagraphs.question: Why is it that a football team playing at home usually scores more goals than when playing away?
drillParagraphs.answer: The reason a football team … is that the players are surrounded by their home fans, who encourage them by cheering
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么足球队在主场踢球通常比客场进球多？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 足球队之所以成立……是因为球员们被主场球迷包围，球迷通过欢呼来鼓励他们

drillParagraphs.question: How many points does one need to score to win a game of table tennis?
drillParagraphs.answer: One needs to score 11 (or 21) points to win a game of table tennis
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 一场乒乓球比赛需要得多少分才能获胜？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 一场乒乓球比赛需要得到 11（或 21）分才能获胜

drillParagraphs.question: After setting off (or setting out) on a journey, what sort of things do people often realize they've forgotten to take with them?
drillParagraphs.answer: After …, people often realize they've forgotten to take their money, passport, keys etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 出发（或出发）旅行后，人们经常意识到自己忘记带什么东西？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 之后......，人们常常意识到他们忘记带钱、护照、钥匙等。

drillParagraphs.question: Why should a market trader take care to set out his goods attractively on his stall?
drillParagraphs.answer: A market trader should take care … to make them look better and therefore attract more customers
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么市场商人应该小心地将他的商品摆在他的摊位上？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 市场交易者应该注意……让它们看起来更好，从而吸引更多客户

drillParagraphs.question: What's another meaning of the word "stall"?
drillParagraphs.answer: Another meaning … is when an engine fails to keep going
drillParagraphs.questionZh: “摊”字还有什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 另一个含义……是当发动机无法继续运转时

drillParagraphs.question: Does a major earthquake have the power to wipe out an entire town?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 一场大地震有能力摧毁整个城镇吗？

drillParagraphs.question: If you knew that a family member was deliberately not paying their income tax, would you turn a blind eye to it or say something to them about it?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你知道某个家庭成员故意不缴纳所得税，你会视而不见或对他们说些什么吗？

drillParagraphs.question: When someone's in debt to a bank but they don't face up to the fact and therefore make no attempt to pay off the debt, what happens?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, the debt grows bigger and bigger as a result of interest charges
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当某人欠银行债务但他们不正视事实并因此不尝试偿还债务时，会发生什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当......时，由于利息费用，债务变得越来越大

drillParagraphs.question: When you're speaking in English and you can't find the words you need to get across a particular idea, how do you feel?
drillParagraphs.answer: When I'm … and I can't find …, I feel frustrated, disappointed etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当您用英语说话并且找不到表达特定想法所需的单词时，您有何感受？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我……而我找不到……时，我会感到沮丧、失望等。

drillParagraphs.question: Why is it so essential to revise (or review) all past work before an examination?
drillParagraphs.answer: It is so essential … to fill in the gaps in our memory
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么在考试前修改（或复习）所有过去的作业如此重要？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 填补我们记忆中的空白是非常重要的

drillParagraphs.question: If a colleague of yours seemed annoyed with you for no apparent reason, would you ignore their behaviour or ask them what the matter was?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你的同事似乎无缘无故地对你生气，你会忽略他们的行为或询问他们出了什么事吗？

drillParagraphs.question: What's a bandage?
drillParagraphs.answer: A bandage is a long piece of fabric that we wrap around an injury to keep it clean and stop any bleeding
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么是绷带？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 绷带是一块长织物，我们将其包裹在伤口上以保持伤口清洁并止血

drillParagraphs.question: Have you ever had any weird experiences in your life that you're unable to explain?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你的生活中是否有过一些无法解释的奇怪经历？

drillParagraphs.question: When do people gasp?
drillParagraphs.answer: People gasp when they receive a sudden shock, or when they can finally breathe in after swimming under water for a long time, for example
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 人什么时候会喘气？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 例如，当人们受到突然的电击时，或者在水下游泳很长时间后终于可以呼吸时，就会喘气

drillParagraphs.question: In reference to writing, what do we mean by a report?
drillParagraphs.answer: In …, … a highly organized document, written for a specific person or group of people, that provides information on a particular situation or event
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 说到写作，我们所说的报告是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 在……中，……组织严密的文档，为特定的人或一群人编写，提供有关特定情况或事件的信息

drillParagraphs.question: When we write a report, who's most likely to be our target audience?
drillParagraphs.answer: When …, our target audience … our boss at work, or a member of another organization or committee
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当我们撰写报告时，谁最有可能成为我们的目标受众？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当......，我们的目标受众......我们的老板，或其他组织或委员会的成员

drillParagraphs.question: Therefore, what writing style should we use?
drillParagraphs.answer: We should use a formal and impersonal style
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 那么，我们应该采用什么样的写作风格呢？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们应该使用正式且客观的风格

drillParagraphs.question: What are two common ways of starting a report?
drillParagraphs.answer: Two … by using a title, or by using "to", "from" and "subject" lines, as in an email
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 开始报告的两种常见方式是什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 两个……通过使用标题，或使用“收件人”、“发件人”和“主题”行，如电子邮件中那样

drillParagraphs.question: Which two pieces of information do we normally put in the introduction paragraph?
drillParagraphs.answer: Two … the aim of the report, and where we got our information from
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们通常在引言段落中放入哪两条信息？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 二……报告的目的，以及我们从哪里获得信息

drillParagraphs.question: Why do we normally give each paragraph a subheading when writing a report?
drillParagraphs.answer: … to make it clear to the reader what each paragraph is about
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么我们在撰写报告时通常会给每个段落一个小标题？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: ...让读者清楚每个段落的内容

drillParagraphs.question: Should the main paragraphs of a report mainly state facts, or give our own personal opinions?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 报告的主要段落应该主要陈述事实，还是发表自己的个人观点？

drillParagraphs.question: So where do we normally write our own opinions?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 那么我们通常在哪里写自己的观点呢？

drillParagraphs.question: What else do we often put in the conclusion?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们经常在结论中加上什么？

drillParagraphs.question: Have you ever tripped over your shoelaces?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你有被鞋带绊倒过吗？

drillParagraphs.question: And are some of these infections potentially fatal?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 其中一些感染是否可能致命？

drillParagraphs.question: Who's the most influential leader your country's had in the last hundred years or so?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 谁是你们国家近百年来最有影响力的领导人？

drillParagraphs.question: How many layers of brick do you reckon a wall two metres high consists of?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你认为两米高的墙由多少层砖组成？

drillParagraphs.question: Do most businesses run at a loss for a while when they're first established before they manage to break even?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 大多数企业在刚成立时是否都会亏损一段时间才能实现收支平衡？

drillParagraphs.question: What's the opposite of "at a loss"?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: “亏本”的反义词是什么？

drillParagraphs.question: Does your mother (or wife, girlfriend etc.) have a specific perfume that she always wears?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你的母亲（或妻子、女朋友等）有一种她经常使用的特定香水吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you have good vision (eyesight?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你的视力好吗（视力？

drillParagraphs.question: If someone can only see objects clearly when they're quite far away, are they short-sighted or long-sighted?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果一个人只有在很远的地方才能看清楚物体，那么他是近视还是远视？

drillParagraphs.question: When did the medium of television become available to the average household?
drillParagraphs.answer: The medium … during the second half of the 20th century
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 电视媒体是什么时候进入普通家庭的？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you think printed media such as books and newspapers will eventually disappear?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您认为书籍和报纸等印刷媒体最终会消失吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Are the media in your country entitled to report whatever they like?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你们国家的媒体有权随心所欲地报道吗？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you agree that social media sites such as … can, in fact, end up making people less sociable?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 您是否同意诸如……之类的社交媒体网站实际上最终会降低人们的社交能力？

drillParagraphs.question: How come it's so difficult for parents to assess their children's progress at school objectively?
drillParagraphs.answer: It's so … because their feelings for their children can prevent them from judging things reasonably
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 为什么家长很难客观地评估孩子在学校的进步？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是如此……因为他们对孩子的感情会阻止他们合理地判断事情

drillParagraphs.question: What's the opposite of "objective"?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: “客观”的反义词是什么？

drillParagraphs.question: If you didn't hang on (or hold on) to something when standing up on a moving bus, what might happen?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果您在行驶的公交车上站立时没有抓住（或抓住）某物，可能会发生什么？

drillParagraphs.question: How can you stop a window rattling in the wind?
drillParagraphs.answer: You can … by pushing a small wedge of wood, card or cloth into the gap between the window and the frame
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如何才能阻止窗户在风中嘎嘎作响？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 您可以……将一小块木头、卡片或布塞入窗户和窗框之间的间隙

drillParagraphs.question: Which type of food is often sold in wedge-shaped blocks?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 哪种类型的食品经常以楔形块形式出售？

drillParagraphs.question: What would I mean if I said I saw a terrific film last night?
drillParagraphs.answer: If …, you'd mean you saw a very good film
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果我说我昨晚看了一部很棒的电影是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果……，你就意味着你看了一部非常好的电影

drillParagraphs.question: Was there a terrific amount of technological progress during the last century?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 上个世纪是否有巨大的技术进步？

drillParagraphs.question: If you fold a piece of paper in half twice, unfold it, and then tear along the creases, how many pieces of paper do you end up with?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果你把一张纸对折两次，展开，然后沿着折痕撕开，你最终会得到多少张纸？

drillParagraphs.question: Which counts more, in your view: the salary you earn or the type of work you do?
drillParagraphs.answer: In my view, the … counts more than …
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在您看来，哪个更重要：您赚取的薪水还是您从事的工作类型？

drillParagraphs.question: Of all the people you know, who do you feel you could really count on for support in a crisis?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 在您认识的所有人中，您认为在危机中您真正可以依靠谁的支持？

drillParagraphs.question: If this school were organizing a free mountain-climbing trip this weekend, could we count you in or would you tell us to count you out?
drillParagraphs.answer: If this …, you could count me in ~ If this …, I'd tell you to count me out
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果这所学校这个周末组织一次免费的登山旅行，我们可以把你算进去还是你告诉我们把你排除在外？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果这个……，你可以把我算进去~如果这个……，我会告诉你把我排除在外

drillParagraphs.question: What meaning can the prefix "en-" add to a word?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 前缀“en-”可以给单词添加什么意思？

drillParagraphs.question: What meaning can the prefix "mis-" add to a word?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 前缀“mis-”可以给单词添加什么意思？

drillParagraphs.question: What meaning can the prefix "ex-" add to a word?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 前缀“ex-”可以添加到单词中什么意思？

drillParagraphs.question: Do you believe that humans have a soul that carries on living after death?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 你相信人死后有灵魂继续存在吗？
