flashcards.definition: A person who is below the age of majority, consent, criminal responsibility or other adult responsibilities and accountabilities.
flashcards.example: It is illegal to sell weapons to minors under the age of eighteen.
flashcards.definitionZh: 未达到法定成年年龄、同意年龄、刑事责任或其他成人责任和义务的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 向十八岁以下未成年人出售武器是违法的。

flashcards.definition: More than half (50%) of some group.
flashcards.example: The majority agreed that the new proposal was the best.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某些群体的一半以上 (50%)。
flashcards.exampleZh: 大多数人同意新提案是最好的。

flashcards.definition: Any subgroup that does not form a numerical majority.
flashcards.example: Most people agreed, but a sizable minority were upset by the decision.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何未形成人数多数的小组。
flashcards.exampleZh: 大多数人都同意，但也有相当一部分人对这一决定感到不安。

flashcards.definition: A lever operated by one's foot that is used to control or power a machine or mechanism, such as a bicycle or piano
flashcards.example: A piano usually has two or three pedals.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用脚操作的杠杆，用于控制或驱动机器或机构，例如自行车或钢琴
flashcards.exampleZh: 钢琴通常有两个或三个踏板。

flashcards.definition: To modify.
flashcards.example: Morimoto's recipes are adjusted to suit the American palate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 修改。
flashcards.exampleZh: 森本的食谱经过调整以适应美国人的口味。

flashcards.definition: To make sure or certain of something (usually some future event or condition).
flashcards.example: I use an alarm clock to ensure that I get up on time.
flashcards.definitionZh: 确定或确定某事（通常是未来的某些事件或情况）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我使用闹钟来确保我准时起床。

flashcards.definition: Brand or kind; model.
flashcards.example: What make of car do you drive?
flashcards.definitionZh: 品牌或种类；模型。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您开什么牌子的车？

flashcards.definition: A person attached to a particular pursuit, study, or science as to music or painting; especially one who cultivates any study or art, from taste or attachment, without pursuing it professionally.
flashcards.example: The contest is only open to amateurs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 热衷于音乐或绘画等特定追求、研究或科学的人；尤其是那些出于品味或执着而培养任何研究或艺术的人，而不是专业地追求它。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该比赛仅对业余爱好者开放。

flashcards.definition: A book specially designed to keep photographs, stamps, or autographs.
flashcards.example: This is the word Album.
flashcards.definitionZh: 专为保存照片、邮票或亲笔签名而设计的书。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是专辑这个词。

flashcards.definition: An organizer that papers are kept in, usually with an index tab, to be stored as a single unit in a filing cabinet.
flashcards.example: I keep all my schoolwork in a yellow folder.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种存放纸张的组织器，通常带有索引标签，以便作为一个单元存储在文件柜中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我把所有的作业都放在一个黄色的文件夹里。

flashcards.definition: Anything recently released or made available (as for sale).
flashcards.example: The video store advertised that it had all the latest releases.
flashcards.definitionZh: 最近发布或提供的任何东西（如待售）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这家音像商店宣称拥有所有最新版本。

flashcards.definition: Vigilant or on one's guard against danger or difficulty.
flashcards.example: Stay aware! Don't let your guard down.
flashcards.definitionZh: 警惕或警惕危险或困难。
flashcards.exampleZh: 保持警惕！不要放松警惕。

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: Significance, importance.
flashcards.example: It was a matter of great import.
flashcards.definitionZh: 意义，重要性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是一件非常重要的事情。

flashcards.definition: Something that is exported
flashcards.example: Oil is the main export of Saudi Arabia.
flashcards.definitionZh: 出口的东西
flashcards.exampleZh: 石油是沙特阿拉伯的主要出口产品。

flashcards.definition: Raw materials, agricultural and other primary products as objects of large-scale trading in specialized exchanges.
flashcards.example: The price of crude oil is determined in continuous trading between professional players in World's many commodities exchanges.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以原材料、农产品等初级产品为对象，在专门交易所进行大规模交易。
flashcards.exampleZh: 原油的价格是由世界众多商品交易所的专业人士之间的持续交易决定的。

flashcards.definition: An increase in size, number, value, or strength.
flashcards.example: Growth was dampened by a softening of the global economy in 2001, but picked up in the subsequent years due to strong growth in China.
flashcards.definitionZh: 尺寸、数量、价值或强度的增加。
flashcards.exampleZh: 2001年，增长因全球经济疲软而受到抑制，但由于中国的强劲增长，随后几年有所回升。

flashcards.definition: Frugal use of resources.
flashcards.example: economy of word
flashcards.definitionZh: 节约使用资源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 言语经济

flashcards.definition: The action or an instance of sending something out, particularly:
flashcards.example: The issue of the directive from the treasury prompted the central bank's most recent issue of currency.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发送某物的动作或实例，特别是：
flashcards.exampleZh: 财政部指令的发布促使央行最近一次发行货币。

flashcards.definition: To switch on
flashcards.example: Can you on the light?
flashcards.definitionZh: 开启
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能开灯吗？

flashcards.definition: To make very dirty; to cover in filth.
flashcards.example: This is the word Filthy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使非常肮脏；覆盖污物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是肮脏这个词。

flashcards.definition: Of a large size or extent; great.
flashcards.example: a grand army
flashcards.definitionZh: 尺寸或范围较大；伟大的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一支伟大的军队

flashcards.definition: Grand, elegant or splendid in appearance.
flashcards.example: This is the word Magnificent.
flashcards.definitionZh: 外观宏伟、典雅或辉煌。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是伟大这个词。

flashcards.definition: An item of clothing (usually worn by a woman or young girl) which both covers the upper part of the body and includes skirts below the waist.
flashcards.example: Amy and Mary looked very pretty in their dresses.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种衣服（通常由妇女或年轻女孩穿着），既覆盖上半身又包括腰部以下的裙子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 艾米和玛丽穿着衣服看起来非常漂亮。

flashcards.definition: A wager, an agreement between two parties that a stake (usually money) will be paid by the loser to the winner (the winner being the one who correctly forecast the outcome of an event).
flashcards.example: Dylan owes Fletcher $30 from an unsuccessful bet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种赌注，两方之间达成的协议，即输家将向赢家支付赌注（通常是金钱）（赢家是正确预测事件结果的人）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 迪伦因一次不成功的赌注而欠弗莱彻 30 美元。

flashcards.definition: A pronged connecting device which fits into a mating socket, especially an electrical one.
flashcards.example: I pushed the plug back into the electrical socket and the lamp began to glow again.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种插入配合插座（尤其是电气插座）的插脚连接装置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我将插头重新插入电源插座，灯又开始发光。

flashcards.definition: A tool used to remove material so as to create a hole, typically by plunging a rotating cutting bit into a stationary workpiece.
flashcards.example: Wear safety glasses when operating an electric drill.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种用于去除材料以形成孔的工具，通常通过将旋转切削头插入固定工件来实现。
flashcards.exampleZh: 操作电钻时佩戴防护眼镜。

flashcards.definition: To purchase an option on something.
flashcards.example: The new novel was optioned by the film studio, but they'll probably never decide to make a movie from it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 购买某物的期权。
flashcards.exampleZh: 电影制片厂选择了这部新小说，但他们可能永远不会决定将其拍成电影。

flashcards.definition: A butt or mark to shoot at, as for practice, or to test the accuracy of a firearm, or the force of a projectile.
flashcards.example: Take careful aim at the target.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用来射击的枪托或标记，用于练习，或测试枪支的准确性或射弹的力量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 小心瞄准目标。

flashcards.definition: To designate the site or place of; to define the limits of (Note: the designation may be purely descriptive: it need not be prescriptive.)
flashcards.example: The council must locate the new hospital
flashcards.definitionZh: 指定地点或地点；定义限制（注意：该名称可能纯粹是描述性的：它不必是规定性的。）
flashcards.exampleZh: 委员会必须找到新医院

flashcards.definition: (grammar) Consisting of multiple words, but behaving as a single part of speech.
flashcards.example: phrasal preposition
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）由多个单词组成，但表现为单个词类。
flashcards.exampleZh: 短语介词

flashcards.definition: The terminal point of something in space or time.
flashcards.example: At the end of the road, turn left.
flashcards.definitionZh: 空间或时间中某物的终点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在路的尽头左转。

flashcards.definition: The power to enforce rules or give orders.
flashcards.example: I have the authority to penalise the staff in my department, but not the authority to sack them.
flashcards.definitionZh: 执行规则或发出命令的权力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我有权处罚我部门的员工，但无权解雇他们。

flashcards.definition: To feel resentment over; to consider as an affront.
flashcards.example: The bride greatly resented being left at the church.
flashcards.definitionZh: 感到怨恨；视为一种侮辱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 新娘对被留在教堂感到非常不满。

flashcards.definition: Subject; theme; a category or general area of interest.
flashcards.example: A society where a topic cannot be discussed, does not have free speech.
flashcards.definitionZh: 主题;主题;感兴趣的类别或一般领域。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个不能讨论话题的社会就没有言论自由。

flashcards.definition: Fully assured in opinion.
flashcards.example: I’m absolutely positive you've spelt that wrong.
flashcards.definitionZh: 意见完全放心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我绝对肯定你拼写错误。

flashcards.definition: A telephone conversation.
flashcards.example: I received several calls today.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次电话交谈。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天我接到几个电话。

flashcards.definition: Extreme force.
flashcards.example: The violence of the storm, fortunately, was more awesome than destructive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 极力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 幸运的是，风暴的威力与其说是破坏性的，不如说是可怕的。

flashcards.definition: Signifying something; carrying meaning.
flashcards.example: a significant word or sound; a significant look
flashcards.definitionZh: 表示某事；承载意义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 重要的单词或声音；一个重要的外观

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: A meeting, especially one that is unplanned or unexpected.
flashcards.example: Their encounter was a matter of chance.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次会议，尤其是一次计划外或意外的会议。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们的相遇纯属偶然。

flashcards.definition: (where the frame of reference is within the ship) At or towards the stern of a ship.
flashcards.example: The after gun is abaft the forward gun.
flashcards.definitionZh: （参考系位于船内）位于船尾或朝向船尾。
flashcards.exampleZh: 后炮位于前炮后方。

flashcards.definition: A telephone conversation.
flashcards.example: I received several calls today.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次电话交谈。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天我接到几个电话。

flashcards.definition: (plural mediums or media) A tool used for painting or drawing.
flashcards.example: Acrylics, oils, charcoal, and gouache are all mediums I used in my painting.
flashcards.definitionZh: （复数媒介或媒体）用于绘画或绘图的工具。
flashcards.exampleZh: 丙烯、油画、木炭和水粉都是我在绘画中使用的媒介。

flashcards.definition: The homestretch.
flashcards.example: And it's Uncle Mo in front by two as they come to the top of the lane.
flashcards.definitionZh: 最后冲刺。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他们来到巷子尽头时，莫叔叔在前面走着两个。

flashcards.definition: (parts of Australia) A broad highway designed for high speed traffic, having restrictions on the vehicle types permitted and merging lanes instead of cross traffic; in parts of the United States and other places called freeway.
flashcards.example: This is the word Motorway.
flashcards.definitionZh: （澳大利亚部分地区）专为高速交通而设计的宽阔高速公路，对允许的车辆类型有限制，并合并车道而不是交叉交通；在美国部分地区和其他称为高速公路的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是高速公路这个词。

flashcards.definition: To pass a more slowly moving object or entity.
flashcards.example: The car was so slow we were overtaken by a bus.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过移动速度较慢的物体或实体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 汽车开得很慢，我们被一辆公共汽车超越了。

flashcards.definition: A small quantity of a liquid substance etc.; less than 1/8 of a teaspoon.
flashcards.example: Add a dash of vinegar.
flashcards.definitionZh: 少量液体物质等；少于 1/8 茶匙。
flashcards.exampleZh: 加少许醋。

flashcards.definition: The act of cutting.
flashcards.example: He made a fine cut with his sword.
flashcards.definitionZh: 切割的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他用剑划出了一道细痕。

flashcards.definition: From a specified time in the past.
flashcards.example: A short/long time since
flashcards.definitionZh: 从过去的某个指定时间开始。
flashcards.exampleZh: 很短/很长一段时间以来

flashcards.definition: To express (an action, thought or idea) by means of particular words.
flashcards.example: I wasn't sure how to phrase my condolences without sounding patronising.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过特定的词语来表达（行动、思想或想法）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不知道如何表达我的哀悼而又不显得居高临下。

flashcards.definition: A watchword or rallying cry, a verbal signal (even when consisting of multiple words).
flashcards.example: mum's the word
flashcards.definitionZh: 口号或战斗口号，口头信号（即使由多个单词组成）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 妈妈的话

flashcards.definition: (modal auxiliary verb, defective) To have permission to, be allowed. Used in granting permission and in questions to make polite requests.
flashcards.example: you may smoke outside;  may I sit there?
flashcards.definitionZh: （情态助动词，有缺陷的）获得许可，被允许。用于授予许可和在提问中提出礼貌的请求。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您可以在外面吸烟；  我可以坐那儿吗？

flashcards.definition: Physical strength or force.
flashcards.example: He pushed with all his might, but still it would not move.
flashcards.definitionZh: 体力或力量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他用尽全力一推，它还是纹丝不动。

flashcards.definition: (auxiliary verb, defective) To know how to; to be able to.
flashcards.example: She can speak English, French, and German.   I can play football.   Can you remember your fifth birthday?
flashcards.definitionZh: （助动词，有缺陷的）知道如何；能够。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她会说英语、法语和德语。   我会踢足球。   你还记得你的五岁生日吗？

flashcards.definition: To resign from (a job, office, position, etc.).
flashcards.example: After having to work overtime without being paid, I quit my job.
flashcards.definitionZh: 辞去（工作、办公室、职位等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 由于加班没有工资，我辞掉了工作。

flashcards.definition: To have, show or express sympathy; to be affected by feelings similar to those of another, in consequence of knowing the person to be thus affected.
flashcards.example: This is the word Sympathize.
flashcards.definitionZh: 表示同情、表达同情；由于知道受此影响的人而受到与他人相似的感受的影响。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是同情这个词。

flashcards.definition: In a condition of bankruptcy; unable to pay one's debts.
flashcards.example: a bankrupt merchant
flashcards.definitionZh: 处于破产状态；无力偿还债务。
flashcards.exampleZh: 破产商人

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word suicide.
flashcards.example: This is the word suicide.
flashcards.definitionZh: 自杀这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是自杀这个词。

flashcards.definition: To have (a person) enter an establishment, such as a hospital or asylum, as a patient.
flashcards.example: Tony should be committed to a nuthouse!
flashcards.definitionZh: 让（一个人）作为病人进入某个机构，例如医院或庇护所。
flashcards.exampleZh: 托尼应该被关进疯人院！

flashcards.definition: A contest, especially for spelling; see spelling bee.
flashcards.example: geography bee
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场比赛，尤其是拼写比赛；参见拼字比赛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 地理蜜蜂

flashcards.definition: Negates the meaning of the modified verb.
flashcards.example: Did you take out the trash? No, I did not.
flashcards.definitionZh: 否定被修饰动词的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你倒垃圾了吗？不，我没有。

flashcards.definition: The part of the forelimb below the forearm or wrist in a human, and the corresponding part in many other animals.
flashcards.example: Her hands are really strong.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人类前臂或手腕下方的前肢部分，以及许多其他动物的相应部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她的手真的很有力。

flashcards.definition: A gift to the poor or needy.
flashcards.example: It's a place to get a hand up, not a handout.
flashcards.definitionZh: 送给穷人或有需要的人的礼物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是一个举手的地方，而不是施舍的地方。

flashcards.definition: The amount of bending that something undergoes when a force is applied to it; a tendency to yield under pressure; resilence.
flashcards.example: There is no give in his dogmatic religious beliefs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当某物受力时所经历的弯曲量；在压力下有屈服的倾向；韧性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他没有屈服于教条式的宗教信仰。

flashcards.definition: A small plant leaf.
flashcards.example: The new leaflets at the end of the branch were a lighter shade of green than the mature leaves.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一片小植物叶子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 树枝末端的新小叶比成熟的叶子呈浅绿色。

flashcards.definition: A person who is passing by (that is, walking past).
flashcards.example: When he tripped and fell in the street, several kind passers-by helped him up.
flashcards.definitionZh: 路过的人（即走过去的人）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他在街上绊倒时，好心的路人把他扶了起来。

flashcards.definition: To gain, usually by one's own exertions; to get as one's own
flashcards.example: He acquired a title.
flashcards.definitionZh: 获得，通常是通过自己的努力；占为己有
flashcards.exampleZh: 他获得了一个头衔。

flashcards.definition: A car with automatic transmission.
flashcards.example: I never learned to drive a stick. I can only drive an automatic.
flashcards.definitionZh: 配备自动变速箱的汽车。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我从来没有学过驾驶棍子。我只能开自动挡。

flashcards.definition: To belabour, to emphasise or expand upon (a point in a debate, etc).
flashcards.example: I think we've all got the idea. There's no need to labour the point.
flashcards.definitionZh: 强调、强调或扩展（辩论中的某一点等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我想我们都明白了。没有必要费力说明这一点。

flashcards.definition: The decision or judgement of a jury or court; a verdict.
flashcards.example: The court returned a sentence of guilt in the first charge, but innocence in the second.
flashcards.definitionZh: 陪审团或法院的决定或判决；一个判决。
flashcards.exampleZh: 法院对第一项指控作出有罪判决，但对第二项指控作出无罪判决。

flashcards.definition: The act of seizing or capturing.
flashcards.example: The catch of the perpetrator was the product of a year of police work.
flashcards.definitionZh: 夺取或夺取的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 抓获肇事者是警方一年工作的成果。

flashcards.definition: Hard to deal with, complicated
flashcards.example: They were in a tricky situation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 很难处理，很复杂
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们的处境很棘手。

flashcards.definition: Something nasty.
flashcards.example: Processed foods are full of aspartame and other nasties.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有些令人讨厌的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 加工食品富含阿斯巴甜和其他有害物质。

flashcards.definition: To continue or carry on, despite obstacles or hardships; to persist.
flashcards.example: The singer's popularity endured for decades.
flashcards.definitionZh: 尽管有障碍或困难，仍继续或继续下去；坚持下去。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这位歌手的受欢迎程度持续了数十年。

flashcards.definition: To be the editor of a publication.
flashcards.example: He edits the Chronicle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 成为一家刊物的编辑。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他编辑编年史。

flashcards.definition: A person who edited a specific document.
flashcards.example: John Johnson wrote this term paper and the editor was Joan Johnson.
flashcards.definitionZh: 编辑特定文档的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 约翰·约翰逊撰写了这篇学期论文，编辑是琼·约翰逊。

flashcards.definition: To issue (something, such as printed work) for distribution and/or sale.
flashcards.example: Most of the sketches Faulkner published in 1925 appeared in the Sunday magazine section of the New Orleans Times-Picayune.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发行（某物，例如印刷作品）以供分发和/或销售。
flashcards.exampleZh: 福克纳 1925 年发表的大部分草图都出现在《新奥尔良时报-皮卡尤恩》的星期日杂志版块上。

flashcards.definition: Aromatic or pungent plant matter (usually dried) used to season or flavour food.
flashcards.example: This is the word Spice.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于给食物调味或调味的芳香或辛辣植物物质（通常是干燥的）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是香料这个词。

flashcards.definition: Of, pertaining to, or containing spice.
flashcards.example: He prepared a spicy casserole.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于、关于或含有香料的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他准备了一份麻辣砂锅。

flashcards.definition: A feeling of love or strong attachment.
flashcards.example: I have a lot of affection for my little sister.
flashcards.definitionZh: 爱的感觉或强烈的依恋。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对我的小妹妹很有感情。

flashcards.definition: A person who specializes in the science of chemistry, especially at a professional level.
flashcards.example: This is the word Chemist.
flashcards.definitionZh: 专门研究化学科学，尤其是专业水平的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是化学家这个词。

flashcards.definition: The branch of natural science that deals with the composition and constitution of substances and the changes that they undergo as a consequence of alterations in the constitution of their molecules.
flashcards.example: This is the word Chemistry.
flashcards.definitionZh: 自然科学的一个分支，研究物质的组成和构成以及由于其分子构成的改变而发生的变化。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是化学这个词。

flashcards.definition: A land area free of woodland, cities, and towns; open country.
flashcards.example: There are several species of wild flowers growing in this field.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有林地、城市和城镇的土地区域；野外。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这片田野里生长着多种野花。

flashcards.definition: A domestic dispute, whether verbal or violent
flashcards.example: 2005: Bellingham-Whatcom County Commission Against Domestic Violence, Domestic Violence in Whatcom County (read on the Whatcom County website athttps//web.archive.org/web/20060618212243/http://www.co.whatcom.wa.us/boards/dv_whatcom042505.pdf on 20 May 2006) - The number of “verbal domestics” (where law enforcement determines that no assault has occurred and where no arrest is made), decreased significantly.
flashcards.definitionZh: 家庭纠纷，无论是口头的还是暴力的
flashcards.exampleZh: 2005 年：贝灵厄姆-霍特科姆县反家庭暴力委员会，霍特科姆县的家庭暴力（请参阅霍特科姆县网站 https://web.archive.org/web/20060618212243/http://www.co.whatcom.wa.us/boards/dv_whatcom042505.pdf，2006 年 5 月 20 日） - “言语家庭暴力”的数量（其中法律执法部门确定没有发生袭击事件，也没有逮捕任何人），显着减少。

flashcards.definition: An implement, an instrument or apparatus designed (or at least used) as a means to a specific end (often specified), especially:
flashcards.example: This is the word Appliance.
flashcards.definitionZh: 设计（或至少使用）作为达到特定目的（通常指定）的手段的工具、仪器或装置，特别是：
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“Appliance”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A literary work which brings together or arranges systematically parallel passages of historians respecting the same events, and shows their agreement or consistency.
flashcards.example: a harmony of the Gospels
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种文学作品，系统地汇集或排列历史学家关于同一事件的平行段落，并表明它们的一致性或一致性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 福音书的和谐

flashcards.definition: The legal dissolution of a marriage.
flashcards.example: Richard obtained a divorce from his wife some years ago, but hasn't returned to the dating scene.
flashcards.definitionZh: 合法解除婚姻关系。
flashcards.exampleZh: 理查德几年前与妻子离婚，但一直没有回到约会现场。

flashcards.definition: To happen or take place.
flashcards.example: The liftoff will occur in exactly twelve seconds.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发生或发生。
flashcards.exampleZh: 升空将在十二秒内完成。

flashcards.definition: Of a surface, having low friction, often due to being covered in a non-viscous liquid, and therefore hard to grip, hard to stand on without falling, etc.
flashcards.example: Oily substances render things slippery.
flashcards.definitionZh: 表面具有低摩擦力，通常由于被非粘性液体覆盖，因此难以抓握、难以站立而不跌倒等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 油性物质使物体变得光滑。

flashcards.definition: One who drives a motor vehicle.
flashcards.example: This is the word Motorist.
flashcards.definitionZh: 驾驶机动车的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“驾车者”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Possessing physical features, behaviors, personality traits or other properties that are mainly attributed to infants and small or cuddly animals; e.g. fair, dainty, round, and soft physical features, disproportionately large eyes and head, playfulness, fragility, helplessness, curiosity or shyness, innocence, affectionate behavior.
flashcards.example: Our reaction to cute attributes is understood as the way nature ensures mammals care for their young.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拥有主要归因于婴儿和小动物或可爱动物的身体特征、行为、性格特征或其他特性；例如公平、精致、圆润、柔软的身体特征，不成比例的大眼睛和头部，顽皮、脆弱、无助、好奇或害羞、天真、深情的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们对可爱属性的反应被理解为大自然确保哺乳动物照顾幼崽的方式。

flashcards.definition: Anything regarded as larger or more powerful than one of its normal size or strength.
flashcards.example: That is a beast of a stadium.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何被认为比其正常尺寸或强度更大或更强大的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那是体育场的野兽。

flashcards.definition: The largest of the apes, native to the forests of central Africa, and known for their trait of knuckle-walking.
flashcards.example: This is the word Gorilla.
flashcards.definitionZh: 最大的猿类，原产于非洲中部的森林，以其指关节行走的特征而闻名。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是大猩猩这个词。

flashcards.definition: The harvested seeds of various grass food crops eg: wheat, corn, barley.
flashcards.example: We stored a thousand tons of grain for the winter.
flashcards.definitionZh: 收获的各种草类粮食作物的种子，例如：小麦、玉米、大麦。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们储存了一千吨粮食过冬。

flashcards.definition: A very small piece of matter, a fragment; especially, the smallest possible part of something.
flashcards.example: This is the word Particle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 非常小的一块物质，一个碎片；特别是某事物的最小可能部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是粒子这个词。

flashcards.definition: The outward-projecting parts of the pelvis and top of the femur and the overlying tissue.
flashcards.example: This is the word Hip.
flashcards.definitionZh: 骨盆和股骨顶部以及上面的组织向外突出的部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是臀部这个词。

flashcards.definition: A complete domicile occupying only part of a building, especially one for rent; a flat.
flashcards.example: This is the word Apartment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 仅占据建筑物一部分的完整住所，尤其是出租的住所；一套公寓。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是公寓这个词。

flashcards.definition: Someone or thing who lives in a place.
flashcards.example: This is the word Inhabitant.
flashcards.definitionZh: 居住在某个地方的人或物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“居民”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To think about seriously.
flashcards.example: Consider that we’ve had three major events and the year has hardly begun.
flashcards.definitionZh: 要认真思考一下。
flashcards.exampleZh: 考虑一下我们已经发生了三件重大事件，而这一年才刚刚开始。

flashcards.definition: The result of a contest that neither side has won; a tie.
flashcards.example: The game ended in a draw.
flashcards.definitionZh: 双方均未获胜的比赛结果；领带。
flashcards.exampleZh: 比赛以平局结束。

flashcards.definition: Exciting wonder or surprise; astonishing; wonderful.
flashcards.example: I went to a marvellous party last week.
flashcards.definitionZh: 令人兴奋的奇迹或惊喜；惊人;精彩的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 上周我参加了一个很棒的聚会。

flashcards.definition: The act of vacating something; moving out.
flashcards.example: The Conservative Party’s vacation of the centre ground gave an opportunity to its opponents.
flashcards.definitionZh: 腾出某物的行为；搬出去。
flashcards.exampleZh: 保守党退出中间地带，给了反对者可乘之机。

flashcards.definition: Selection, array.
flashcards.example: We sell a wide range of cars.
flashcards.definitionZh: 选择，排列。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们销售各种汽车。

flashcards.definition: The midline of any generally spherical object, such as a fruit or vegetable, that has identifiable poles.
flashcards.example: Slice the onion through the equator.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何具有可识别极点的大致球形物体（例如水果或蔬菜）的中线。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将洋葱穿过赤道切片。

flashcards.definition: An annual publication; a book, periodical, journal, report, comic book, yearbook, etc., which is published serially once a year, which may or may not be in addition to regular weekly or monthly publication.
flashcards.example: I read the magazine, but I usually don't purchase the annuals.
flashcards.definitionZh: 年度出版物；每年连载一次的书籍、期刊、期刊、报告、漫画书、年鉴等，可以是也可以不是定期出版的周刊或月刊。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我读杂志，但通常不购买年刊。

flashcards.definition: A composition, normally in prose, telling a story and intended to be represented by actors impersonating the characters and speaking the dialogue
flashcards.example: This is the word Drama.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种作品，通常是散文，讲述一个故事，并由演员模仿角色并说出对话来表现
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是戏剧这个词。

flashcards.definition: Anything resembling a necklace in shape.
flashcards.example: a necklace of coral islands
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何形状类似于项链的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 珊瑚岛项链

flashcards.definition: A band or chain worn around the wrist as jewelry/jewellery or an ornament.
flashcards.example: This is the word Bracelet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 作为珠宝/珠宝或装饰品戴在手腕上的带子或链子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是手链这个词。

flashcards.definition: Widely known to the public; familiar.
flashcards.example: a household word; a household name
flashcards.definitionZh: 为公众广泛知晓；熟悉的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 家喻户晓的词；家喻户晓的名字

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word be worried.
flashcards.example: This is the word be worried.
flashcards.definitionZh: 担心这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是担心这个词。

flashcards.definition: A task, especially a difficult, unpleasant, or routine one.
flashcards.example: Washing dishes is a chore, but we cannot just stop eating.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一项任务，尤其是一项困难的、不愉快的或例行公事的任务。
flashcards.exampleZh: 洗碗是一件苦差事，但我们不能就这样停止吃饭。

flashcards.definition: Overpowering fright, often affecting groups of people or animals.
flashcards.example: This is the word Panic.
flashcards.definitionZh: 压倒性的恐惧，常常影响人群或动物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是恐慌这个词。

flashcards.definition: To make a short, loud, explosive noise with the vocal organs (said of animals, especially dogs).
flashcards.example: The neighbour's dog is always barking.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用发声器官（指动物，尤其是狗）发出短促、响亮、爆炸性的声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 邻居家的狗总是狂吠。

flashcards.definition: The mark or impression left by a foot; a track.
flashcards.example: The child watched as his footsteps in the sand were washed away by the waves.
flashcards.definitionZh: 脚留下的痕迹或印象；一条轨道。
flashcards.exampleZh: 孩子看着自己在沙滩上的足迹被海浪冲走。

flashcards.definition: To commit burglary.
flashcards.example: This is the word Burgle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 犯盗窃罪。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“Burgle”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who breaks in to premises with the intent of committing theft
flashcards.example: The burglar made off with a large diamond from the museum.
flashcards.definitionZh: 意图盗窃而闯入房屋的人
flashcards.exampleZh: 窃贼从博物馆偷走了一颗大钻石。

flashcards.definition: (sometimes derogatory) A psychiatrist or psychotherapist.
flashcards.example: My shrink said that he was an enabler, bad for me.
flashcards.wordZh: 缩水 缩水 缩水
flashcards.definitionZh: （有时是贬义的）精神科医生或心理治疗师。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的心理医生说他是一个推动者，对我不利。

flashcards.definition: A gathering of people for the purchase and sale of merchandise at a set time, often periodic.
flashcards.example: The privilege to hold a weekly market was invaluable for any feudal era burgh.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人们在规定的时间（通常是周期性的）聚集在一起购买和销售商品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对于任何封建时代的城镇来说，每周举办一次集市的特权都是无价的。

flashcards.definition: To think long and carefully, in bewilderment.
flashcards.example: We puzzled over the curious-shaped lock, but were unable to discover how the key should be inserted.
flashcards.definitionZh: 陷入困惑之中，仔细地思考了很久。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们对形状奇特的锁感到困惑，但不知道钥匙应该如何插入。

flashcards.definition: The highest value reached by some quantity in a time period.
flashcards.example: The stock market reached a peak in September 1929.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某个时间段内某个数量达到的最高值。
flashcards.exampleZh: 1929 年 9 月，股市达到顶峰。

flashcards.definition: A peak; the topmost point or surface, as of a mountain.
flashcards.example: In summer, it is possible to hike to the summit of Mount Shasta.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个高峰；最高点或表面，如山。
flashcards.exampleZh: 夏季，可以徒步前往沙斯塔山的山顶。

flashcards.definition: Significant; worth considering.
flashcards.example: I've spent a considerable amount of time on this.
flashcards.definitionZh: 重要的;值得考虑。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我在这方面花费了大量的时间。

flashcards.definition: A quality of an object experienced by touch.
flashcards.example: Bark has a rough feel.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过触摸体验到的物体的品质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 树皮有粗糙的感觉。

flashcards.definition: A quality of an object experienced by touch.
flashcards.example: Bark has a rough feel.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过触摸体验到的物体的品质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 树皮有粗糙的感觉。

flashcards.definition: To disappoint or defeat; to vex by depriving of something expected or desired.
flashcards.example: It frustrates me to do all this work and then lose it all.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使失望或失败；因剥夺预期或想要的东西而烦恼。
flashcards.exampleZh: 完成所有这些工作然后又失去一切，这让我很沮丧。

flashcards.definition: A silly person.
flashcards.example: This is the word Silly.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个愚蠢的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是傻这个词。

flashcards.definition: An act of pulling (applying force)
flashcards.example: He gave the hair a sharp pull and it came out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉动（施加力）的行为
flashcards.exampleZh: 他猛地一拉头发，头发就掉了出来。

flashcards.definition: An act of pulling (applying force)
flashcards.example: He gave the hair a sharp pull and it came out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉动（施加力）的行为
flashcards.exampleZh: 他猛地一拉头发，头发就掉了出来。

flashcards.definition: A colourant, especially one that has an affinity to the substrate to which it is applied.
flashcards.example: This is the word Dye.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种着色剂，尤其是对其所施加的基材具有亲和力的着色剂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是染料这个词。

flashcards.definition: To change greatly the appearance or form of.
flashcards.example: The alchemists sought to transform lead into gold.
flashcards.definitionZh: 极大地改变…的外观或形式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 炼金术士试图将铅变成金。

flashcards.definition: To restrict or limit.
flashcards.example: He was restrained by the straight jacket.
flashcards.definitionZh: 限制或限制。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他被直筒夹克束缚住了。

flashcards.definition: That which attends, or relates to, or in some way affects, a fact or event; an attendant thing or state of things.
flashcards.example: This is the word Circumstance.
flashcards.definitionZh: 涉及、涉及、或以某种方式影响事实或事件的事物；伴随的事物或事物的状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“环境”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A cutting; a part cut out from the rest of something.
flashcards.example: This is the word Section.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次切割；从某物的其余部分中切出的一部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“节”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A decision reached after careful thought.
flashcards.example: The board has come to the conclusion that the proposed takeover would not be in the interest of our shareholders.
flashcards.definitionZh: 经过深思熟虑后做出的决定。
flashcards.exampleZh: 董事会得出的结论是，拟议的收购不符合我们股东的利益。

flashcards.definition: The establishment of communication (with).
flashcards.example: I haven't been in contact with her for years.
flashcards.definitionZh: 建立通讯（与）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我已经很多年没有和她联系了。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word word-building exercise.
flashcards.example: This is the word word-building exercise.
flashcards.definitionZh: 单词构建练习的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是单词构词练习。

flashcards.definition: A general fact or proposition; a generality.
flashcards.example: We have dealt with the generals; now let us turn to the particulars.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一般事实或主张；一个普遍性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们已经对付过将军了；现在让我们谈谈细节。

flashcards.definition: A set of symbols and marks which are used to clarify meaning in text by separating strings of words into clauses, phrases and sentences.
flashcards.example: This is the word Punctuation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一组符号和标记，用于通过将单词字符串分成从句、短语和句子来阐明文本中的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是标点符号这个词。

flashcards.definition: (of a Web page) To contain a hyperlink to another page.
flashcards.example: My homepage links to my wife's.
flashcards.definitionZh: （网页）包含到另一个页面的超链接。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的主页链接到我妻子的主页。

flashcards.definition: A single item of clothing.
flashcards.example: This is the word Garment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一件衣服。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是服装这个词。

flashcards.definition: To give power or authority (to do something).
flashcards.example: A passport entitles the bearer to travel to other countries.
flashcards.definitionZh: 给予权力或权威（做某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 护照使持有人有权前往其他国家旅行。

flashcards.definition: A situation that is presented, a scenario
flashcards.example: The software patent landscape has changed considerably in the last years
flashcards.definitionZh: 所呈现的情况、情景
flashcards.exampleZh: 软件专利格局在过去几年中发生了很大变化

flashcards.definition: (of a person or place) Very beautiful.
flashcards.example: All the contest judges agreed that Brigitt was absolutely gorgeous.
flashcards.definitionZh: （人或地方）非常美丽。
flashcards.exampleZh: 所有比赛评委都认为布丽吉特非常漂亮。

flashcards.definition: (usually in phrases such as 'from the off', 'at the off', etc.) Beginning; starting point.
flashcards.example: He has been very obviously an untrustworthy narrator right from the off.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常用“from the off”、“at the off”等短语） 开始；起点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 显然，他从一开始就是一个不值得信任的叙述者。

flashcards.definition: A pill; a small, easily swallowed portion of a substance.
flashcards.example: Many people take vitamin tablets as a food supplement.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一颗药丸；物质的一小部分，容易吞咽。
flashcards.exampleZh: 许多人服用维生素片作为食品补充剂。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word dose.
flashcards.example: This is the word dose.
flashcards.definitionZh: 剂量这个词的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是剂量这个词。

flashcards.definition: A subtle allusion.
flashcards.example: The film includes a wink to wartime rationing.
flashcards.definitionZh: 微妙的暗示。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这部电影对战时配给眨眼。

flashcards.definition: To close and reopen both eyes quickly.
flashcards.example: The loser in the staring game is the person who blinks first.
flashcards.definitionZh: 快速闭上并重新睁开双眼。
flashcards.exampleZh: 凝视游戏中的失败者是先眨眼的人。

flashcards.definition: Capable of being perceived very clearly.
flashcards.example: Her voice was distinct despite the heavy traffic.
flashcards.definitionZh: 能够被非常清楚地感知。
flashcards.exampleZh: 尽管交通繁忙，她的声音还是清晰的。

flashcards.definition: (of time) To take or use.
flashcards.example: This is the word Occupy.
flashcards.definitionZh: （时间）采取或使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是占领这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who occupies an office or a position.
flashcards.example: I cannot say the same of the current occupant of the position
flashcards.definitionZh: 担任办公室或职位的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不能对这个职位的现任占有者说同样的话

flashcards.definition: Full extent; distance between extreme limits; especially; the distance between the nearest surfaces of two bodies, or the space between walls.
flashcards.example: a room ten feet square in the clear

flashcards.definition: An earthenware container, either with two or no handles, for holding oil, water, wine, etc., or used for burial.

flashcards.definitionZh: 一种陶器容器，有两个把手或无把手，用于盛油、水、酒等，或用于埋葬。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是罐子这个词。

flashcards.definition: A term of affection.
flashcards.example: Honey, I'm home.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个表达感情的词语。
flashcards.exampleZh: 亲爱的，我回来了。

flashcards.definition: To express gratitude or appreciation toward.
flashcards.example: She thanked him for the lift.
flashcards.definitionZh: 表示感谢或赞赏。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她感谢他搭车。

flashcards.definition: Of or relating to fable, myth or legend.
flashcards.example: This is the word Fabulous.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于寓言、神话或传说的或与之相关的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是美妙这个词。

flashcards.definition: (in combination) clothing
flashcards.example: footwear; outdoor wear; maternity wear
flashcards.definitionZh: （组合）服装
flashcards.exampleZh: 鞋类；户外服装；孕妇装

flashcards.definition: Excessive activity, worry, bother, or talk about something.
flashcards.example: They made a big fuss about the wedding plans.
flashcards.definitionZh: 过度活动、担心、打扰或谈论某事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们对婚礼计划大惊小怪。

flashcards.definition: Anxious or particular about petty details.
flashcards.example: This is the word Fussy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对小细节感到焦虑或挑剔。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是挑剔这个词。

flashcards.definition: A set of normal procedures, often performed mechanically.
flashcards.example: Connie was completely robotic and emotionless by age 12; her entire life had become one big routine.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一组通常机械执行的正常程序。
flashcards.exampleZh: 康妮 12 岁时就完全变成了机器人，没有感情。她的整个生活都变成了一件大事。

flashcards.definition: A process or execution of a program.
flashcards.example: The user killed the frozen task.
flashcards.definitionZh: 程序的过程或执行。
flashcards.exampleZh: 用户杀死了冻结的任务。

flashcards.definition: To change with time or a similar parameter.
flashcards.example: He varies his magic tricks so as to minimize the possibility that any given audience member will see the same trick twice.
flashcards.definitionZh: 随着时间或类似参数的变化。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他会改变他的魔术，以尽量减少任何特定观众看到同一魔术两次的可能性。

flashcards.definition: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.
flashcards.example: The femur has a clean break and so should heal easily.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将某物分成两块或更多块的实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 股骨已完全断裂，因此应该很容易愈合。

flashcards.definition: Something or someone of any value; any portion of one's property or effects so considered.
flashcards.example: These shares are a valuable asset.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有任何价值的东西或人；如此考虑的一个人的财产或财物的任何部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这些股票是宝贵的资产。

flashcards.definition: Not easy; difficult.
flashcards.example: This is the word Uneasy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不容易；难的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是不安这个词。

flashcards.definition: An administrative division of an area.
flashcards.example: the Soho district of London
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个地区的行政区划。
flashcards.exampleZh: 伦敦苏豪区

flashcards.definition: Each of the main continuous land-masses on the earth's surface, now generally regarded as seven in number, including their related islands, continental shelves etc.
flashcards.example: This is the word Continent.
flashcards.definitionZh: 地球表面的每一个主要的连续陆地，现在一般认为有七个，包括它们相关的岛屿、大陆架等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是大陆这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of settling.
flashcards.example: This is the word Settlement.
flashcards.definitionZh: 解决的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是结算这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who retails groceries (foodstuffs and household items) from a grocery.
flashcards.example: This is the word Grocer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从杂货店零售杂货（食品和家居用品）的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是杂货商这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who sells fresh vegetables and fruit, normally from a relatively small shop
flashcards.example: This is the word Greengrocer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 出售新鲜蔬菜和水果的人，通常来自相对较小的商店
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是蔬菜水果商这个词。

flashcards.definition: To make distinct or separate, particularly:
flashcards.example: This is the word Specialize.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使不同或分开，特别是：
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“专业化”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An attempt.
flashcards.example: I gave unicycling a try but I couldn’t do it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次尝试。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我尝试过骑独轮车，但我做不到。

flashcards.definition: An attempt.
flashcards.example: I gave unicycling a try but I couldn’t do it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次尝试。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我尝试过骑独轮车，但我做不到。

flashcards.definition: High fidelity
flashcards.example: This is the word Hi-fi.
flashcards.definitionZh: 高保真度
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是Hi-fi这个词。

flashcards.definition: One who makes a speech to an audience.
flashcards.example: The company hired a motivational speaker to boost morale.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向观众发表演讲的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该公司聘请了一位励志演讲者来鼓舞士气。

flashcards.definition: Having a secondary, supplementary or subordinate function by accompanying as a subordinate; aiding in a secondary way; being additional; being connected as an incident or subordinate to a principal; contributing or being contributory. Said of people and things, and, when of people, usually in a bad sense
flashcards.example: She was accessory to the riot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过作为下属陪同而具有次要、补充或从属职能；以次要方式提供帮助；是额外的；与事件相关或隶属于负责人；贡献或正在贡献。指人或事时，指人时，通常带有不好的意思
flashcards.exampleZh: 她是骚乱的同谋。

flashcards.definition: A watchword or rallying cry, a verbal signal (even when consisting of multiple words).
flashcards.example: mum's the word
flashcards.definitionZh: 口号或战斗口号，口头信号（即使由多个单词组成）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 妈妈的话

flashcards.definition: A toy in the form of a human.
flashcards.example: This is the word Doll.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人形的玩具。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是娃娃这个词。

flashcards.definition: A contrivance, usually of brass or iron, and furnished with points, worn to protect the hand, to add force to a blow, and to disfigure the person struck; a knuckle duster.
flashcards.example: brass knuckles
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种通常由黄铜或铁制成的装置，带有尖端，磨损后可以保护手，增加打击力，并使被击中的人毁容；指节掸子
flashcards.exampleZh: 指节铜套

flashcards.definition: A passenger vehicle for public use that runs on tracks in the road (called a streetcar or trolley in North America).
flashcards.example: This is the word Tram.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在道路轨道上运行的供公众使用的客运车辆（在北美称为有轨电车或无轨电车）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是电车这个词。

flashcards.definition: An item of clothing other than a mitten, covering all or part of the hand and fingers, but usually allowing independent movement of the fingers.
flashcards.example: I wore gloves to keep my hands warm.
flashcards.definitionZh: 除手套外的一种衣服，覆盖全部或部分手和手指，但通常允许手指独立运动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我戴着手套来保暖双手。

flashcards.definition: Any system by which time is divided into days, weeks, months, and years.
flashcards.example: The three principal calendars are the Gregorian, Jewish, and Islamic calendars.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将时间分为日、周、月和年的任何系统。
flashcards.exampleZh: 三种主要历法是公历、犹太历和伊斯兰历。

flashcards.definition: A decorative border.
flashcards.example: the fringe of a picture
flashcards.definitionZh: 装饰边框。
flashcards.exampleZh: 图片的边缘

flashcards.definition: A small particle of glowing matter, either molten or on fire.
flashcards.example: This is the word Spark.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发光物质的小颗粒，要么熔化，要么着火。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是火花这个词。

flashcards.definition: To flow or gush as if from a fountain.
flashcards.example: Lava fountained from the volcano.
flashcards.definitionZh: 如同从喷泉中流淌或涌出一样。
flashcards.exampleZh: 熔岩从火山中喷涌而出。

flashcards.definition: (authorship) One of the main sections into which the text of a book is divided.
flashcards.example: Detective novel writers try to keep up the suspense until the last chapter.
flashcards.definitionZh: （作者身份）一本书的文本分为的主要部分之一。
flashcards.exampleZh: 侦探小说作家试图将悬念保持到最后一章。

flashcards.definition: A criminal who plunders at sea; commonly attacking merchant vessels, though often pillaging port towns.
flashcards.example: You should be cautious due to the Somali pirates.
flashcards.definitionZh: 海上掠夺的罪犯；通常攻击商船，但也经常掠夺港口城镇。
flashcards.exampleZh: 由于索马里海盗，您应该小心谨慎。

flashcards.definition: (communications) A system for transmitting television or Internet services over a network of coaxial or fibreoptic cables.
flashcards.example: I tried to watch the movie last night but my cable was out.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通信）通过同轴或光纤电缆网络传输电视或互联网服务的系统。
flashcards.exampleZh: 昨晚我想看这部电影，但我的电缆没电了。

flashcards.definition: A vehicle used in farms e.g. for pulling farm equipment and preparing the fields.
flashcards.example: This is the word Tractor.
flashcards.definitionZh: 农场使用的车辆，例如用于拉动农具和准备田地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是拖拉机这个词。

flashcards.definition: A tree (Prunus persica), native to China and now widely cultivated throughout temperate regions, having pink flowers and edible fruit.
flashcards.example: This is the word Peach.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种树（Prunus persica），原产于中国，现在在整个温带地区广泛种植，有粉红色的花朵和可食用的果实。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是桃字。

flashcards.definition: A growth of facial hair between the nose and the upper lip.
flashcards.example: This is the word Moustache.
flashcards.definitionZh: 鼻子和上唇之间生长的面部毛发。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“小胡子”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A plan, drawing, sketch or outline to show how something works, or show the relationships between the parts of a whole.
flashcards.example: Electrical diagrams show device interconnections.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于显示某事物如何工作或显示整体各部分之间关系的计划、绘图、草图或轮廓。
flashcards.exampleZh: 电气图显示设备互连。

flashcards.definition: Mutual; shared by more than one.
flashcards.example: The two competitors have the common aim of winning the championship.
flashcards.definitionZh: 相互的;被多个人共享。
flashcards.exampleZh: 两位选手有着共同的目标，那就是夺得冠军。

flashcards.definition: In a relative manner; often used when comparing lists, where the term denotes that the items in the lists correspond to each other in the order they are given.
flashcards.example: Serena Williams and Roger Federer won the women's and men's singles titles, respectively, at the 2010 Australian Open.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以相对的方式；在比较列表时经常使用，该术语表示列表中的项目按照给出的顺序相互对应。
flashcards.exampleZh: 塞雷娜·威廉姆斯和罗杰·费德勒在 2010 年澳大利亚网球公开赛上分别赢得了女子和男子单打冠军。

flashcards.definition: To keep back; to retain.
flashcards.example: We reserve the right to make modifications.
flashcards.definitionZh: 保持退后；保留。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们保留进行修改的权利。

flashcards.definition: (auxiliary verb, defective) To know how to; to be able to.
flashcards.example: She can speak English, French, and German.   I can play football.   Can you remember your fifth birthday?
flashcards.definitionZh: （助动词，有缺陷的）知道如何；能够。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她会说英语、法语和德语。   我会踢足球。   你还记得你的五岁生日吗？

flashcards.definition: A situation which poses an immediate risk and which requires urgent attention.
flashcards.example: Cardiac arrest is an emergency and if you find someone in cardiac arrest you should call 999 immediately.
flashcards.definitionZh: 造成直接风险并需要紧急关注的情况。
flashcards.exampleZh: 心脏骤停是一种紧急情况，如果您发现有人心脏骤停，请立即拨打 999。

flashcards.definition: To kick.
flashcards.example: I booted the ball toward my teammate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 踢。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我把球踢向我的队友。

flashcards.definition: Terrorism
flashcards.example: a terror attack; the War on Terror
flashcards.definitionZh: 恐怖主义
flashcards.exampleZh: 恐怖袭击；反恐战争

flashcards.definition: A person, group, or organization that uses violent action, or the threat of violent action, to further political goals.
flashcards.example: This is the word Terrorist.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使用暴力行动或暴力行动威胁来实现政治目标的个人、团体或组织。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是恐怖分子这个词。

flashcards.definition: An inhabitant or occupant: a member of any place.
flashcards.example: Diogenes reckoned himself a citizen of the world.
flashcards.definitionZh: 居民或占有者：任何地方的成员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 第欧根尼认为自己是世界公民。

flashcards.definition: Violating morality or decency; provoking indignation or affront.
flashcards.example: This is the word Outrageous.
flashcards.definitionZh: 违反道德或礼仪；引起愤慨或侮辱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是无耻这个词。

flashcards.definition: To draw or let out wholly; to drain off completely
flashcards.example: Moisture of the earth is exhausted by evaporation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完全抽出或出租；完全排干
flashcards.exampleZh: 地球上的水分通过蒸发而耗尽。

flashcards.definition: Of sinews and tendons.
flashcards.example: This is the word Nervous.
flashcards.definitionZh: 筋和腱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“紧张”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
flashcards.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）获得；获取。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definition: A protective coating given to wood or metal and other surfaces.
flashcards.example: The car's finish was so shiny and new.
flashcards.definitionZh: 木材或金属和其他表面的保护涂层。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这辆车的表面是如此闪亮和崭新。

flashcards.definition: Emotions, kindness, moral effort, or spirit in general.
flashcards.example: The team lost, but they showed a lot of heart.
flashcards.definitionZh: 情感、善良、道德努力或一般精神。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然球队输了，但他们表现出了很大的勇气。

flashcards.definition: Directly related, connected, or pertinent to a topic.
flashcards.example: His mother provided some relevant background information concerning his medical condition.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与主题直接相关、连接或相关。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的母亲提供了一些有关他的健康状况的相关背景信息。

flashcards.definition: An act of stamping the foot, paw or hoof.
flashcards.example: The horse gave two quick stamps and rose up on its hind legs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跺脚、爪子或蹄子的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 马飞快地跺了两下，后腿站了起来。

flashcards.definition: A geometrical figure consisting of two straight lines or bars intersecting each other such that at least one of them is bisected by the other.
flashcards.example: Put a cross for a wrong answer and a tick for a right one.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由两条彼此相交的直线或条组成的几何图形，其中至少一条被另一条平分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 错误答案打叉，正确答案打勾。

flashcards.definition: To say something in return; to answer; to reply.
flashcards.example: to respond to a question or an argument
flashcards.definitionZh: 说些话作为回报；回答；回复。
flashcards.exampleZh: 回答问题或争论

flashcards.definition: (grammar) An inflected form of a verb that indicates tense.
flashcards.example: English only has a present tense and a past tense; it has no future tense.
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）表示时态的动词的屈折形式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 英语只有现在时和过去时；它没有将来时。

flashcards.definition: To make stiff.
flashcards.example: This is the word Stiffen.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使之僵硬。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“僵化”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To take hold of, particularly with the hand.
flashcards.example: After a few slips, the tires gripped the pavement.
flashcards.definitionZh: 抓住，特别是用手。
flashcards.exampleZh: 经过几次打滑后，轮胎紧紧抓住了路面。

flashcards.definition: To take hold of, particularly with the hand.
flashcards.example: After a few slips, the tires gripped the pavement.
flashcards.definitionZh: 抓住，特别是用手。
flashcards.exampleZh: 经过几次打滑后，轮胎紧紧抓住了路面。

flashcards.definition: To stir the emotions of.
flashcards.example: The fireworks which opened the festivities excited anyone present.
flashcards.definitionZh: 来搅动对方的情绪。
flashcards.exampleZh: 庆祝活动拉开序幕的烟花让在场的每个人都兴奋不已。

flashcards.definition: A young cat, especially before sexual maturity (reached at about seven months).
flashcards.example: This is the word Kitten.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一只年轻的猫，尤其是在性成熟之前（大约七个月）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是小猫这个词。

flashcards.definition: A (generic) thing; particularly something that is a nuisance; a sucker.
flashcards.example: I have another two dozen of these puppies to finish before I can go home.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个（通用）事物；特别是令人讨厌的事情；一个傻瓜。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在我回家之前，我还有两打这样的小狗需要完成。

flashcards.definition: To supply with armour or (later especially) weapons.
flashcards.example: The king armed his knights with swords and shields.
flashcards.definitionZh: 提供盔甲或（后来特别是）武器。
flashcards.exampleZh: 国王用剑和盾牌武装他的骑士。

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: A criminal armed with a gun, especially a professional killer.
flashcards.example: This is the word Gunman.
flashcards.definitionZh: 持枪的罪犯，尤其是职业杀手。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是枪手这个词。

flashcards.definition: In dire need of something.
flashcards.example: I hadn't eaten in two days and was desperate for food.
flashcards.definitionZh: 急需某样东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我已经两天没吃东西了，非常想吃东西。

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: Able to be seen.
flashcards.example: When the sun rises, the world becomes visible.
flashcards.definitionZh: 能被看见。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当太阳升起时，世界就变得清晰可见。

flashcards.definition: Conforming to, or recognised by the laws of society.
flashcards.example: Lawful money is always a land asset and can only be issued by an actual land jurisdiction government — not a corporation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 符合或被社会法律认可。
flashcards.exampleZh: 合法货币始终是土地资产，只能由实际的土地管辖政府（而不是公司）发行。

flashcards.definition: Prohibited; not permitted by law (either civil or criminal law; see illegal).
flashcards.example: He was charged with unlawful use of a car.
flashcards.definitionZh: 禁止；法律不允许（民法或刑法；参见非法）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他被指控非法使用汽车。

flashcards.definition: The part of the forelimb below the forearm or wrist in a human, and the corresponding part in many other animals.
flashcards.example: Her hands are really strong.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人类前臂或手腕下方的前肢部分，以及许多其他动物的相应部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她的手真的很有力。

flashcards.definition: The act of observing; perception.
flashcards.example: He took no notice of the changes, and went on as though nothing had happened.
flashcards.definitionZh: 观察的行为；洞察力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他没有注意到这些变化，继续若无其事地继续着。

flashcards.definition: A young person.
flashcards.example: This is the word Youngster.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个年轻人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是年轻人这个词。

flashcards.definition: The way in which something hangs.
flashcards.example: This skirt has a nice hang.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物悬挂的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这条裙子的悬垂感很好。

flashcards.definition: The way in which something hangs.
flashcards.example: This skirt has a nice hang.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物悬挂的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这条裙子的悬垂感很好。

flashcards.definition: The experience or feeling of being pierced or punctured by a small, sharp object.
flashcards.example: I felt a sharp prick as the nurse took a sample of blood.
flashcards.definitionZh: 被小而尖锐的物体刺穿或刺穿的经历或感觉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当护士采集血样时，我感到一阵刺痛。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: A person who is running in an election.
flashcards.example: This is the word Candidate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 参加选举的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是候选人这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who investigates someone or something.
flashcards.example: This is the word Examiner.
flashcards.definitionZh: 调查某人或某事的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是审查员这个词。

flashcards.definition: The food or money required to keep someone alive and healthy; one's support, maintenance.
flashcards.example: He works as a cobbler's apprentice for his keep.
flashcards.definitionZh: 维持某人生存和健康所需的食物或金钱；一个人的支持、维护。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他当补鞋匠的学徒以维持生计。

flashcards.definition: The amount held by a container; a tankful.
flashcards.example: I burned three tanks of gas on the drive to New York.
flashcards.definitionZh: 容器所容纳的数量；一罐。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我在去纽约的路上烧了三箱汽油。

flashcards.definition: A three-dimensional measure of space that comprises a length, a width and a height. It is measured in units of cubic centimeters in metric, cubic inches or cubic feet in English measurement.
flashcards.example: The room is 9x12x8, so its volume is 864 cubic feet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 三维空间测量，包括长度、宽度和高度。公制单位为立方厘米，英制单位为立方英寸或立方英尺。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该房间的尺寸为 9x12x8，因此其体积为 864 立方英尺。

flashcards.definition: To flow over the brim of (a container).
flashcards.example: The river overflowed the levee.
flashcards.definitionZh: 流过（容器）的边缘。
flashcards.exampleZh: 河水漫过堤坝。

flashcards.definition: The originator or creator of a work, especially of a literary composition.
flashcards.example: Have you read any Corinthian authors?
flashcards.definitionZh: 作品（尤其是文学作品）的创作者或创作者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你读过科林斯作家吗？

flashcards.definition: A pair of small loudspeakers worn inside each outer ear or covering all or part of the ear, without a connecting band worn over head.
flashcards.example: This is the word Earphones.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一对小型扬声器，戴在每个外耳内或覆盖整个或部分耳朵，没有戴在头上的连接带。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是耳机这个词。

flashcards.definition: A pair of speakers worn over or in the ears so only the wearer can hear the sound.
flashcards.example: This is the word Headphones.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一对戴在耳朵上或耳朵里的扬声器，这样只有佩戴者才能听到声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是耳机这个词。

flashcards.definition: (of a person) That does not eat meat.
flashcards.example: I have a vegetarian brother
flashcards.definitionZh: （一个人）不吃肉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我有一个吃素的弟弟

flashcards.definition: A person committed to avoiding products and practices that inherently involve animal use, including all foods containing animal products, and to abstaining from direct and intentional harm to animals as far as possible; an adherent to veganism.
flashcards.example: Our vegan-friendly shaving brush is made with synthetic bristles instead of badger hair.
flashcards.definitionZh: 致力于避免使用本质上涉及动物的产品和做法，包括所有含有动物产品的食品，并尽可能避免直接和故意伤害动物；素食主义的信徒。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们的纯素食剃须刷采用合成刷毛而不是獾毛制成。

flashcards.definition: (also dairy products or dairy produce) Products produced from milk.
flashcards.example: This is the word Dairy.
flashcards.definitionZh: （也指乳制品或乳制品）由牛奶生产的产品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是乳制品这个词。

flashcards.definition: The space, area, volume, etc., to which something extends.
flashcards.example: The extent of his knowledge of the language is a few scattered words.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物延伸到的空间、面积、体积等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他对这门语言的了解程度只有几个零散的单词。

flashcards.definition: An order or command.
flashcards.example: I must obey the dictates of my conscience.
flashcards.definitionZh: 命令或命令。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我必须服从我良心的指挥。

flashcards.definition: A small spherical cavity in a solid material.
flashcards.example: bubbles in window glass, or in a lens
flashcards.definitionZh: 固体材料中的小球形空腔。
flashcards.exampleZh: 窗玻璃或镜片中存在气泡

flashcards.definition: Something that helps, or adds power or effectiveness; assistance.
flashcards.example: The controversy gave a boost to the author's sales.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有帮助或增加力量或效率的东西；协助。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这场争议促进了作者的销量。

flashcards.definition: Common enjoyment or possession; participation.
flashcards.example: a community of goods
flashcards.definitionZh: 共同享有或拥有；参与。
flashcards.exampleZh: 商品社区

flashcards.definition: A person, animal or plant living at a certain location or in a certain area.
flashcards.example: The tiger lily is a resident of Asia.
flashcards.definitionZh: 生活在一定地点或一定区域的人、动物或植物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虎百合是亚洲的居民。

flashcards.definition: People in general.
flashcards.example: Young folk, old folk, everybody come, / To our little Sunday School and have a lot of fun.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人一般。
flashcards.exampleZh: 年轻人，老年人，大家都来，/到我们的小主日学校来，玩得很开心。

flashcards.definition: A session of crying.
flashcards.example: Sometimes you just have to have a good weep.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场哭戏。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有时你只需要痛痛快快地哭一场。

flashcards.definition: To such an extent or degree; to the same extent or degree.
flashcards.example: It's not as well made, but it's twice as expensive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 达到这样的程度；达到相同的程度或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然做工不太好，但价格却贵了一倍。

flashcards.definition: A watchword or rallying cry, a verbal signal (even when consisting of multiple words).
flashcards.example: mum's the word
flashcards.definitionZh: 口号或战斗口号，口头信号（即使由多个单词组成）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 妈妈的话

flashcards.definition: Bright and pleasant.
flashcards.example: They enjoyed a cheerful room.
flashcards.definitionZh: 明亮宜人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们享受着一个愉快的房间。

flashcards.definition: To furnish with decorations.
flashcards.example: We decorated the Christmas tree with tinsel and baubles.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用来装饰。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们用金属丝和小玩意装饰圣诞树。

flashcards.definition: The force or energy of a collision of two objects.
flashcards.example: The hatchet cut the wood on impact.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两个物体碰撞的力或能量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 斧头在撞击时砍断了木头。

flashcards.definition: A place other than here.
flashcards.example: This is the word Elsewhere.
flashcards.definitionZh: 除了这里以外的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“别处”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The gases surrounding the Earth or any astronomical body.
flashcards.example: This is the word Atmosphere.
flashcards.definitionZh: 地球或任何天体周围的气体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是气氛这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of founding, fixing, establishing, or beginning to erect.
flashcards.example: The foundation of his institute has been wrought with difficulty.
flashcards.definitionZh: 建立、固定、建立或开始建立的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的研究所的建立是艰难的。

flashcards.definition: The act of collapsing.
flashcards.example: She suffered a terrible collapse after slipping on the wet floor.
flashcards.definitionZh: 崩溃的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她在潮湿的地板上滑倒后严重崩溃。

flashcards.definition: A waiting room in an office, airport etc.
flashcards.example: This is the word Lounge.
flashcards.definitionZh: 办公室、机场等的候诊室。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是休息室这个词。

flashcards.definition: A period during which one is seated for a specific purpose.
flashcards.example: Due to the sheer volume of guests, we had to have two sittings for the meal.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人为了特定目的而坐着的一段时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 由于客人太多，我们不得不坐两顿饭。

flashcards.definition: Fatal; resulting in death.
flashcards.example: terminal cancer
flashcards.definitionZh: 致命的;导致死亡。
flashcards.exampleZh: 晚期癌症

flashcards.definition: A brief look, glance, or peek.
flashcards.example: I only got a glimpse of the car, so I can tell you the colour but not the registration number.
flashcards.definitionZh: 简短的一瞥、一瞥或一瞥。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我只瞥见了这辆车，所以我可以告诉你颜色，但不能告诉你车牌号码。

flashcards.definition: Any of various sulphides, mostly dark-coloured, which have a brilliant metallic lustre.
flashcards.example: copper glance
flashcards.definitionZh: 各种硫化物的任一种，大多为深色，具有明亮的金属光泽。
flashcards.exampleZh: 铜色一瞥

flashcards.definition: At an earlier time.
flashcards.example: I've never done this before.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在较早的时候。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我以前从未这样做过。

flashcards.definition: Easy to use, useful.
flashcards.example: Some people regard duct tape as a handy fix-all.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使用方便，有用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有些人认为管道胶带是一种方便的解决办法。

flashcards.definition: To switch on
flashcards.example: Can you on the light?
flashcards.definitionZh: 开启
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能开灯吗？

flashcards.definition: (used with "of") To eliminate or to get rid of something.
flashcards.example: I dispose of my trash in the garbage can.
flashcards.definitionZh: （与“of”连用）消除或摆脱某物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。

flashcards.definition: Material or resources of a kind lacking commercial value.
flashcards.example: junk fish; junk trees
flashcards.definitionZh: 缺乏商业价值的材料或资源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 垃圾鱼；垃圾树

flashcards.definition: (rarely countable) Unsolicited bulk electronic messages.
flashcards.example: I get far too much spam.
flashcards.definitionZh: （很少可数）未经请求的批量电子消息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我收到太多垃圾邮件。

flashcards.definition: Someone or something living at the same time, or of roughly the same age as another.
flashcards.example: Cervantes was a contemporary of Shakespeare.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与另一个人或事物生活在同一时期或大致相同年龄的人或事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 塞万提斯是莎士比亚的同时代人。

flashcards.definition: An event held to celebrate the launch of a ship/vessel, project, a new book, etc.; a launch party.
flashcards.example: book launch
flashcards.definitionZh: 为庆祝船舶、项目、新书等推出而举办的活动；发布会。
flashcards.exampleZh: 新书发布会

flashcards.definition: A moon or other smaller body orbiting a larger one.
flashcards.example: A spent upper stage is a derelict satellite.
flashcards.definitionZh: 绕较大天体运行的卫星或其他较小天体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 用过的上级是一颗废弃的卫星。

flashcards.definition: A rocket engine.
flashcards.example: This is the word Rocket.
flashcards.definitionZh: 火箭发动机。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是火箭这个词。

flashcards.definition: The organization of knowledge for practical purposes.
flashcards.example: This is the word Technology.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为了实用目的而组织知识。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是科技这个词。

flashcards.definition: Of, relating to, or involving technology, especially modern scientific technology.
flashcards.example: This is the word Technological.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于、涉及或涉及技术，尤其是现代科学技术。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是科技这个词。

flashcards.definition: To move from further away to nearer to.
flashcards.example: She’ll be coming ’round the mountain when she comes [...]
flashcards.definitionZh: 从较远的地方移动到较近的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当她来时，她会绕山而来[...]

flashcards.definition: To be larger, greater than (something).
flashcards.example: The company's 2005 revenue exceeds that of 2004.
flashcards.definitionZh: 变得更大，大于（某物）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 公司2005年的收入超过2004年。

flashcards.definition: Wages, money earned, income.
flashcards.example: This is the word Earnings.
flashcards.definitionZh: 工资，挣的钱，收入。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“收益”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To withdraw more money from an account than there is credit; to make an overdraft
flashcards.example: This is the word Overdrawn.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从账户中提取的资金多于信用额度；透支
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是透支这个词。

flashcards.definition: The amount overdrawn.
flashcards.example: I have an overdraft of £1234.
flashcards.definitionZh: 透支金额。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我透支了 1234 英镑。

flashcards.definition: A lookout; vigilant watch for something.
flashcards.example: to keep sketch
flashcards.definitionZh: 了望台；警惕地观察某事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 保留草图

flashcards.definition: A preliminary plan for a project.
flashcards.example: the outline of a speech
flashcards.definitionZh: 项目的初步计划。
flashcards.exampleZh: 演讲大纲

flashcards.definition: To infuse into; to affect, as with a superior or supernatural influence; to fill with what animates, enlivens or exalts; to communicate inspiration to.
flashcards.example: Elders should inspire children with sentiments of virtue.
flashcards.definitionZh: 注入；影响，如具有优越或超自然的影响力；充满活力、活力或振奋的东西；传达灵感。
flashcards.exampleZh: 长辈要以道德情操来启发孩子。

flashcards.definition: The time when the sun rises.
flashcards.example: She rose before dawn to meet the train.
flashcards.definitionZh: 太阳升起的时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她在黎明前起床去迎接火车。

flashcards.definition: Relating to, or characteristic of life.
flashcards.example: vital energies; vital functions; vital actions
flashcards.definitionZh: 与生活有关或具有生活特征。
flashcards.exampleZh: 生命能量；重要功能；重要行动

flashcards.definition: To provide with welfare or aid.
flashcards.example: welfaring the poor
flashcards.definitionZh: 提供福利或援助。
flashcards.exampleZh: 造福穷人

flashcards.definition: To put beyond hazard of losing or of not receiving; to make certain; to assure; frequently with against or from, or formerly with of.
flashcards.example: to secure a creditor against loss; to secure a debt by a mortgage
flashcards.definitionZh: 排除丢失或未收到的危险；确定；保证；经常与反对或来自，或以前与的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 确保债权人免受损失；通过抵押贷款担保债务

flashcards.definition: The condition of not being threatened, especially physically, psychologically, emotionally, or financially.
flashcards.example: This is the word Security.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不受威胁的状态，尤其是在身体、心理、情感或经济上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“安全”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To spend money, time, or energy on something, especially for some benefit or purpose; used with in.
flashcards.example: We'd like to thank all the contributors who have invested countless hours into this event.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为某事花费金钱、时间或精力，特别是为了某种利益或目的；与 in 一起使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们要感谢所有为此活动投入无数时间的贡献者。

flashcards.definition: An annuity paid regularly as benefit due to a retired employee, serviceman etc. in consideration of past services, originally and chiefly by a government but also by various private pension schemes.
flashcards.example: Many old people depend on their pension to pay the bills.
flashcards.definitionZh: 考虑到过去的服务，定期向退休雇员、军人等支付的福利年金，最初主要由政府支付，但也由各种私人养老金计划支付。
flashcards.exampleZh: 许多老年人依靠养老金来支付账单。

flashcards.definition: To have on hand for sale.
flashcards.example: The store stocks all kinds of dried vegetables.
flashcards.definitionZh: 手头有待售。
flashcards.exampleZh: 店里备有各种干菜。

flashcards.definition: A fastening consisting of two metal rings, designed to go around a person's wrists, and connected by a chain or hinge.
flashcards.example: This is the word Handcuffs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由两个金属环组成的紧固件，设计用于环绕人的手腕，并通过链条或铰链连接。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是手铐这个词。

flashcards.definition: The practical aspects of a given art, occupation etc.; formal requirements.
flashcards.example: This is the word Technique.
flashcards.definitionZh: 特定艺术、职业等的实际方面；正式要求。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是技术这个词。

flashcards.definition: A managerial or leading position in certain non-profit organizations, such as political parties, trade unions, international organizations.
flashcards.example: Ban Ki-Moon was a secretary general of the United Nations.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在某些非营利组织（如政党、工会、国际组织）中担任管理或领导职务。
flashcards.exampleZh: 潘基文曾任联合国秘书长。

flashcards.definition: A standard measure of a quantity.
flashcards.example: The centimetre is a unit of length.
flashcards.definitionZh: 数量的标准度量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 厘米是长度单位。

flashcards.definition: A knitted jacket or jersey, usually of thick wool, worn by athletes before or after exercise.
flashcards.example: This is the word Sweater.
flashcards.definitionZh: 针织夹克或运动衫，通常由厚羊毛制成，供运动员在运动前或运动后穿着。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是毛衣这个词。

flashcards.definition: Someone or something that jumps, e.g. a participant in a jumping event in track or skiing.
flashcards.example: This is the word Jumper.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跳跃的某人或某物，例如田径或滑雪跳跃项目的参与者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是跳线这个词。

flashcards.definition: The most senior rank for an academic at a university or similar institution, informally also known as "full professor." Abbreviated Prof.
flashcards.example: This is the word Professor.
flashcards.definitionZh: 大学或类似机构中学者的最高级别，非正式地也称为“正教授”。缩写教授
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是教授这个词。

flashcards.definition: A spoken lesson or exposition, usually delivered to a group.
flashcards.example: During class today the professor delivered an interesting lecture.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通常向小组进行的口头课程或说明。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天上课时，教授做了一个有趣的讲座。

flashcards.definition: A person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.
flashcards.example: This is the word Lecturer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 讲课的人，尤其是作为职业的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是讲师这个词。

flashcards.definition: The amount of bending that something undergoes when a force is applied to it; a tendency to yield under pressure; resilence.
flashcards.example: There is no give in his dogmatic religious beliefs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当某物受力时所经历的弯曲量；在压力下有屈服的倾向；韧性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他没有屈服于教条式的宗教信仰。

flashcards.definition: (usually with over) To complete.
flashcards.example: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与over）一起完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们说他们可以在两天内转动零件。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
flashcards.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）获得；获取。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definition: A brief recreational trip; a journey out of the usual way.
flashcards.example: While driving home I took an excursion and saw some deer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 短暂的休闲旅行；一次不寻常的旅程。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在开车回家的路上，我进行了一次短途旅行，看到了一些鹿。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word look at.
flashcards.example: This is the word look at.
flashcards.definitionZh: 看这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是看这个词。

flashcards.definition: A portable or wearable timepiece.
flashcards.example: More people today carry a watch on their wrists than in their pockets.
flashcards.definitionZh: 便携式或可穿戴计时器。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如今，更多的人将手表戴在手腕上，而不是放在口袋里。

flashcards.definition: A state of readiness for potential combat.
flashcards.example: an airborne alert; ground alert
flashcards.definitionZh: 为潜在战斗做好准备的状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 空中警报；地面警报

flashcards.definition: To throw into confusion or disorder.
flashcards.example: Hecklers disrupted the man's speech.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使混乱或混乱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 质问者打断了该男子的讲话。

flashcards.definition: To halt something temporarily.
flashcards.example: The meeting was suspended for lunch.
flashcards.definitionZh: 暂时停止某事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 会议因午餐而暂停。

flashcards.definition: Someone who likes to talk about other people's private or personal business.
flashcards.example: Be careful what you say to him: he’s a bit of a gossip.
flashcards.definitionZh: 喜欢谈论别人的私人或个人事务的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 小心你对他说的话：他有点八卦。

flashcards.definition: Freedom provided by the cessation of activities.
flashcards.example: This is the word Leisure.
flashcards.definitionZh: 停止活动所提供的自由。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是休闲这个词。

flashcards.definition: To follow, travel down (a particular way, course of action etc.).
flashcards.example: Her rival pursued a quite different course.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跟随、向下行进（特定的方式、行动过程等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她的竞争对手采取了完全不同的做法。

flashcards.definition: One of a group of nymphs who lured mariners to their death on the rocks.
flashcards.example: This is the word Siren.
