flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: The brilliance or warmth of color in an environment or on a person (especially one's face).
flashcards.example: He had a bright red glow on his face.
flashcards.definitionZh: 环境或人（尤其是人脸）上颜色的光彩或温暖。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的脸上泛着鲜红的光芒。

flashcards.definition: A fireplace or pit for grilling food, typically used outdoors and traditionally employing hot charcoal as the heating medium.
flashcards.example: We cooked our food on the barbecue.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于烧烤食物的壁炉或坑，通常在户外使用，传统上使用热木炭作为加热介质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们在烧烤炉上煮食物。

flashcards.definition: An abrupt rapping sound, as from an impact of a hard object against wood.
flashcards.example: I heard a knock on my door.
flashcards.definitionZh: 突然的敲击声，就像硬物撞击木头发出的声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我听到有人敲门。

flashcards.definition: An abrupt rapping sound, as from an impact of a hard object against wood.
flashcards.example: I heard a knock on my door.
flashcards.definitionZh: 突然的敲击声，就像硬物撞击木头发出的声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我听到有人敲门。

flashcards.definition: The act of making someone unconscious, or at least unable to come back on their feet within a certain period of time; a TKO.
flashcards.example: The boxer scored a knockout on his opponent.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使某人失去知觉，或至少在一定时间内无法重新站起来的行为；一次技术击倒。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这位拳击手击倒了对手。

flashcards.definition: One who opposes another; one who works or takes a position against someone or something; one who attempts to stop the progress of someone or something.
flashcards.example: During the crackdown, many opponents of the regime were arrested.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人反对另一个人；反对某人或某事或采取反对某人或某事的立场的人；试图阻止某人或某事进展的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在镇压期间，许多反对政权的人被捕。

flashcards.definition: So as to form a circle or trace a circular path, or approximation thereof.
flashcards.example: High above, vultures circled around.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以便形成一个圆或追踪一个圆形路径，或其近似。
flashcards.exampleZh: 高处，秃鹫盘旋。

flashcards.definition: A conveyance; a device for carrying or transporting substances, objects or individuals.
flashcards.example: This is the word Vehicle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 运输工具；用于运载或运输物质、物体或个人的装置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“车辆”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A covered vehicle used for carrying goods or people, usually roughly cuboid in shape, longer and higher than a car but smaller than a truck/lorry.
flashcards.example: The van sped down the road.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于运载货物或人员的有盖车辆，通常形状大致为长方体，比汽车更长、更高，但比卡车/卡车小。
flashcards.exampleZh: 货车在路上飞驰。

flashcards.definition: A semi-tractor ("semi") trailer; a lorry.
flashcards.example: Mexican open-bed trucks haul most of the fresh produce that comes into the United States from Mexico.
flashcards.definitionZh: 半牵引车（“半”）拖车；一辆卡车。
flashcards.exampleZh: 墨西哥的敞篷卡车运送大部分从墨西哥进入美国的新鲜农产品。

flashcards.definition: (said of people towards animals) To breed and raise.
flashcards.example: The family has been rearing cattle for 200 years.
flashcards.definitionZh: （人对动物的说法）繁殖和饲养。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该家族饲养牛已有 200 年历史。

flashcards.definition: Wholly, entirely.
flashcards.example: This is the word Merely.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完全地，完全地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“仅仅”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The money originally invested or loaned, on which basis interest and returns are calculated.
flashcards.example: A portion of your mortgage payment goes to reduce the principal, and the rest covers interest.
flashcards.definitionZh: 最初投资或贷出的资金，在此基础上计算利息和回报。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您的抵押贷款付款的一部分用于减少本金，其余部分用于支付利息。

flashcards.definition: A fundamental assumption or guiding belief.
flashcards.example: We need some sort of principles to reason from.
flashcards.definitionZh: 基本假设或指导信念。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们需要某种原则来推理。

flashcards.definition: Tune; sequence of notes that makes up a musical phrase
flashcards.example: This is the word Melody.
flashcards.definitionZh: 调;组成音乐短语的音符序列
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是旋律这个词。

flashcards.definition: A woman in the context of her own wedding; one who is going to marry or has just been married.
flashcards.example: This is the word Bride.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个女人在她自己的婚礼上；即将结婚或刚刚结婚的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是新娘这个词。

flashcards.definition: A man who is about to marry.
flashcards.example: This is the word Groom bridegroom.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个即将结婚的男人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是新郎新郎这个词。

flashcards.definition: A large group of musicians who play together on various instruments, usually including some from strings, woodwind, brass and/or percussion; the instruments played by such a group.
flashcards.example: This is the word Orchestra.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一大群音乐家一起演奏各种乐器，通常包括弦乐、木管乐器、铜管乐器和/或打击乐器；这样一个团体所演奏的乐器。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是管弦乐队这个词。

flashcards.definition: A violinist.
flashcards.example: The first violin often plays the lead melody lines in a string quartet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一位小提琴家。
flashcards.exampleZh: 第一小提琴经常在弦乐四重奏中演奏主旋律线。

flashcards.definition: A musical instrument of the brass family, generally tuned to the key of B-flat; by extension, any type of lip-vibrated aerophone, most often valveless and not chromatic.
flashcards.example: The royal herald sounded a trumpet to announce their arrival.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种铜管乐器，通常调为降B调；推而广之，任何类型的唇部振动气笛，通常是无阀且非半音阶的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 皇家传令官吹响号角宣布他们的到来。

flashcards.definition: A woodwind instrument consisting of a tube with a row of holes that produce sound through vibrations caused by air blown across the edge of the holes, often tuned by plugging one or more holes with a finger; the Western concert flute, a transverse side-blown flute of European origin.
flashcards.example: This is the word Flute.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种木管乐器，由带有一排孔的管子组成，通过吹过孔边缘的空气引起​​的振动来产生声音，通常通过用手指塞住一个或多个孔来调音；西方音乐会长笛，一种起源于欧洲的横向侧吹长笛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是笛子这个词。

flashcards.definition: To switch on
flashcards.example: Can you on the light?
flashcards.definitionZh: 开启
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能开灯吗？

flashcards.definition: Sorrow, grief.
flashcards.example: This is the word Site.
flashcards.definitionZh: 悲伤，悲伤。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“站点”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Very funny; causing great merriment and laughter.
flashcards.example: a hilarious joke
flashcards.definitionZh: 很搞笑;引起极大的欢乐和笑声。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个搞笑的笑话

flashcards.definition: An act or instance of bursting.
flashcards.example: The bursts of the bombs could be heard miles away.
flashcards.definitionZh: 爆裂的行为或实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 炸弹爆炸的声音几英里外都能听到。

flashcards.definition: A particular view; an examination, especially an official examination, of a particular group of items, in order to ascertain the condition, quantity, or quality.
flashcards.example: A survey of the stores of a ship; a survey of roads and bridges; a survey of buildings.
flashcards.definitionZh: 特定的观点；对一组特定物品的检查，尤其是正式检查，以确定其状况、数量或质量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对船舶物料的调查；道路和桥梁调查；对建筑物的调查。

flashcards.definition: Diligent inquiry or examination to seek or revise facts, principles, theories, applications, etc.; laborious or continued search after truth.
flashcards.example: The research station that houses Wang and his team is outside Lijiang, a city of about 1.2 million people.
flashcards.definitionZh: 勤奋探究或检验，寻求或修正事实、原理、理论、应用等；努力或持续地寻找真理。
flashcards.exampleZh: 王和他的团队所在的研究站位于丽江郊外，这座城市约有 120 万人口。

flashcards.definition: Essential or decisive for determining the outcome or future of something; extremely important.
flashcards.example: A secure supply of crude oil is crucial for any modern nation, let alone a superpower.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对于决定某事的结果或未来至关重要或决定性的；极其重要。
flashcards.exampleZh: 原油的安全供应对于任何现代国家都至关重要，更不用说超级大国了。

flashcards.definition: (usually in the plural) An urban low-income housing building.
flashcards.example: Projects like Pruitt-Igoe were considered irreparably dangerous and demolished.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）城市保障性住房建筑。
flashcards.exampleZh: 像 Pruitt-Igoe 这样的项目被认为具有不可挽回的危险并被拆除。

flashcards.definition: To turn thread or yarn into a piece of fabric by forming loops that are pulled through each other. This can be done by hand with needles or by machine.
flashcards.example: The first generation knitted to order; the second still knits for its own use; the next leaves knitting to industrial manufacturers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过形成相互拉动的线圈，将线或纱线变成一块织物。这可以用针手工完成或通过机器完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 第一代针织定做；第二个仍然编织自用；接下来是针织业的工业制造商。

flashcards.definition: To feel very sad about; to mourn; to sorrow for.
flashcards.example: to grieve one's fate
flashcards.definitionZh: 感到非常悲伤；哀悼；为之悲伤。
flashcards.exampleZh: 哀悼自己的命运

flashcards.definition: To strike with one's fist.
flashcards.example: If she punches me, I'm gonna break her nose.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用拳头击打。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果她打我，我就打断她的鼻子。

flashcards.definition: To control or select something with a dial, or (figuratively) as if with a dial.
flashcards.example: President Trump has recently dialled down the rhetoric.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用转盘控制或选择某些东西，或者（象征性地）就像用转盘一样。
flashcards.exampleZh: 特朗普总统最近缓和了相关言论。

flashcards.definition: One who teases.
flashcards.example: This is the word Tease.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个爱捉弄人的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是挑逗这个词。

flashcards.definition: A fine, gentle, dispersed mist of liquid.
flashcards.example: The sailor could feel the spray from the waves.
flashcards.definitionZh: 细腻、温和、分散的液体雾。
flashcards.exampleZh: 水手可以感觉到海浪溅起的水花。

flashcards.definition: To forbid, disallow, or proscribe officially; to make illegal or illicit.
flashcards.example: The restaurant prohibits smoking on the patio.
flashcards.definitionZh: 正式禁止、禁止或取缔；使非法或违法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 餐厅禁止在露台上吸烟。

flashcards.definition: To clarify something by giving, or serving as, an example or a comparison.
flashcards.example: We illustrate our definitions by including quotations or simple examples.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过给出或作为示例或比较来澄清某事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们通过引用或简单的例子来说明我们的定义。

flashcards.definition: Ruling; governing; prevailing
flashcards.example: The dominant party controlled the government.
flashcards.definitionZh: 裁决;治理；盛行的
flashcards.exampleZh: 执政党控制着政府。

flashcards.definition: A single staccato chord that adds dramatic impact to a composition.
flashcards.example: a horn stab
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个断奏和弦为乐曲增添了戏剧性的影响。
flashcards.exampleZh: 角刺

flashcards.definition: To convey by shouting
flashcards.example: He yelled directions to the party from the car.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过喊叫来传达
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在车里大声喊着去聚会的方向。

flashcards.definition: To detest, hate, revile.
flashcards.example: I absolutely loathe this place.
flashcards.definitionZh: 厌恶、憎恨、谩骂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我绝对讨厌这个地方。

flashcards.definition: A promotional or instructive leaflet inserted into a magazine, newspaper, tape or disk package, etc.
flashcards.example: This software can print compact disc inserts if you have the right size of paper.
flashcards.definitionZh: 插入杂志、报纸、磁带或磁盘包装等中的宣传或指导性传单。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果您有合适的纸张尺寸，该软件可以打印光盘插页。

flashcards.definition: To become aware of, through the physical senses or by thinking; to see; to understand.
flashcards.example: This is the word Perceive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过身体感官或思维来意识到；查看;去理解。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是感知这个词。

flashcards.definition: To destroy.
flashcards.example: They demolished the old mill and put up four townhouses.
flashcards.definitionZh: 摧毁。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们拆除了旧磨坊，盖起了四栋联排别墅。

flashcards.definition: Mutual; shared by more than one.
flashcards.example: The two competitors have the common aim of winning the championship.
flashcards.definitionZh: 相互的;被多个人共享。
flashcards.exampleZh: 两位选手有着共同的目标，那就是夺得冠军。

flashcards.definition: In plural, the first letter of each word of a person's full name considered as a unit.
flashcards.example: You can get your initials printed at the top.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在复数形式中，一个人全名的每个单词的第一个字母被视为一个单位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您可以在顶部印上您姓名的首字母缩写。

flashcards.definition: At the beginning.
flashcards.example: Initially, I found city life incredibly difficult, but now I'm used to it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一开始。
flashcards.exampleZh: 最初，我发现城市生活非常困难，但现在我已经习惯了。

flashcards.definition: To fill with wonder and surprise; to astonish, astound, surprise or perplex.
flashcards.example: He was amazed when he found that the girl was a robot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 充满惊奇和惊喜；使惊讶、惊讶、惊讶或困惑。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他发现这个女孩是一个机器人时，他感到很惊讶。

flashcards.definition: To fill with wonder and surprise; to astonish, astound, surprise or perplex.
flashcards.example: He was amazed when he found that the girl was a robot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 充满惊奇和惊喜；使惊讶、惊讶、惊讶或困惑。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他发现这个女孩是一个机器人时，他感到很惊讶。

flashcards.definition: The time at which something happens.
flashcards.example: A good article will cover the who, the what, the when, the where, the why and the how.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某事发生的时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一篇好的文章将涵盖人物、事件、时间、地点、原因和方式。

flashcards.definition: (of a person) To be in a position in which the upper body is upright and supported by the buttocks.
flashcards.example: After a long day of walking, it was good just to sit and relax.
flashcards.definitionZh: （人的）上半身直立并由臀部支撑的姿势。
flashcards.exampleZh: 经过一整天的步行后，坐下来放松一下也是很好的。

flashcards.definition: A restriction; a boundary, real or metaphorical, caused by some thing or some circumstance.
flashcards.example: Getting into his wheelchair after his amputation, it felt like a limitation you could roll in.
flashcards.definitionZh: 限制；由某些事物或某些情况引起的真实或隐喻的边界。
flashcards.exampleZh: 截肢后坐上轮椅，感觉就像是一个可以滚动的限制。

flashcards.definition: One of the physical properties that are regarded as fundamental measures of a physical quantity, such as mass, length and time.
flashcards.example: The dimension of velocity is length divided by time.
flashcards.definitionZh: 被视为物理量（例如质量、长度和时间）的基本度量的物理属性之一。
flashcards.exampleZh: 速度的量纲是长度除以时间。

flashcards.definition: To choose one or more elements of a set, especially a set of options.
flashcards.example: He looked over the menu, and selected the roast beef.
flashcards.definitionZh: 选择一组中的一个或多个元素，尤其是一组选项。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他看了看菜单，选择了烤牛肉。

flashcards.definition: The process or act of selecting.
flashcards.example: The large number of good candidates made selection difficult.
flashcards.definitionZh: 选择的过程或行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 优秀候选人数量众多，导致选拔困难。

flashcards.definition: A hired worker
flashcards.example: These new recruits were hired after passing the interviews
flashcards.definitionZh: 一名雇佣工人
flashcards.exampleZh: 这些新员工通过面试后被录用

flashcards.definition: Employees; office staff.
flashcards.example: This is the word Personnel.
flashcards.definitionZh: 雇员;办公室工作人员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是人员这个词。

flashcards.definition: One who applies for something; one who makes a request; a petitioner.
flashcards.example: Our job advertisement attracted seven applicants.
flashcards.definitionZh: 申请某事的人；提出请求的人；请愿者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们的招聘广告吸引了七名应聘者。

flashcards.definition: Telling the truth or giving a true result; exact; not defective or faulty
flashcards.example: accurate knowledge
flashcards.definitionZh: 说真话或给出真实结果；精确的;没有缺陷或故障
flashcards.exampleZh: 准确的知识

flashcards.definition: Very large or wide (literally or figuratively).
flashcards.example: The Sahara desert is vast.
flashcards.definitionZh: 非常大或宽（字面上或比喻上）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 撒哈拉沙漠广阔无垠。

flashcards.definition: Motivation to do or achieve something; ability coupled with ambition.
flashcards.example: Crassus had wealth and wit, but Pompey had drive and Caesar as much again.
flashcards.definitionZh: 做某事或取得某事的动机；能力加上野心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 克拉苏拥有财富和智慧，但庞培和凯撒同样拥有动力。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word look at.
flashcards.example: This is the word look at.
flashcards.definitionZh: 看这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是看这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word look at.
flashcards.example: This is the word look at.
flashcards.definitionZh: 看这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是看这个词。

flashcards.definition: That which needs to be, is being, or has been laundered.
flashcards.example: You've left your dirty laundry all over the house.
flashcards.definitionZh: 那些需要被清洗、正在被清洗或已经被清洗的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你把脏衣服扔得满屋子都是。

flashcards.definition: A place that has facilities for washing and drying clothes that the public may pay to use.
flashcards.example: This is the word Launderette.
flashcards.definitionZh: 设有供公众付费使用的洗衣和烘干衣服设施的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是洗衣店这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who has converted to a religion.
flashcards.example: They were all converts to Islam.
flashcards.definitionZh: 皈依宗教的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们都皈依了伊斯兰教。

flashcards.definition: (diminutive) An even number.
flashcards.example: So let's see. There are two evens here and three odds.
flashcards.definitionZh: （小数）偶数。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那么让我们看看。这里有两个偶数和三个奇数。

flashcards.definition: To make uneven.
flashcards.example: This is the word Uneven.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使不平整。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是不均匀这个词。

flashcards.definition: A device pulled through the ground in order to break it open into furrows for planting.
flashcards.example: The horse-drawn plough had a tremendous impact on agriculture.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个装置拉过地面，将其开成犁沟以便种植。
flashcards.exampleZh: 马拉犁对农业产生了巨大影响。

flashcards.definition: (diminutive) An odd number.
flashcards.example: So let's see. There are two evens here and three odds.
flashcards.definitionZh: （小数）奇数。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那么让我们看看。这里有两个偶数和三个奇数。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
flashcards.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）获得；获取。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definition: Digital equipment or technology.
flashcards.example: He moved to digital for the first time, using a Sony camera.
flashcards.definitionZh: 数字设备或技术。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他第一次转向数码相机，使用索尼相机。

flashcards.definition: The act or process of introducing.
flashcards.example: the introduction of a new product into the market
flashcards.definitionZh: 介绍的行为或过程。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将新产品引入市场

flashcards.definition: (nutrition) A sugar, starch, or cellulose that is a food source of energy for an animal or plant.
flashcards.example: These microbes are primarily responsible for breaking down cellulose and other carbohydrates into volatile fatty acids (VFAs).
flashcards.definitionZh: （营养）糖、淀粉或纤维素，是动物或植物的能量食物来源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这些微生物主要负责将纤维素和其他碳水化合物分解成挥发性脂肪酸（VFA）。

flashcards.definition: Any of numerous large, complex naturally-produced molecules composed of one or more long chains of amino acids, in which the amino acid groups are held together by peptide bonds.
flashcards.example: This is the word Protein.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由一个或多个氨基酸长链组成的众多大型、复杂的天然分子中的一种，其中氨基酸基团通过肽键连接在一起。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是蛋白质这个词。

flashcards.definition: To use in place of something else, with the same function.
flashcards.example: I had no shallots so I substituted onion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 代替其他东西使用，具有相同的功能。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我没有青葱，所以我用洋葱代替。

flashcards.definition: A minor fright.
flashcards.example: Johnny had a bad scare last night.
flashcards.definitionZh: 轻微的惊吓。
flashcards.exampleZh: 约翰尼昨晚吓坏了。

flashcards.definition: To reveal, uncover, make visible, bring to light, introduce to.
flashcards.example: This is the word Expose.
flashcards.definitionZh: 揭示、揭露、使可见、暴露、介绍。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“暴露”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A revelation; an uncovering of what was hidden.
flashcards.example: The comedian had been telling us about his sleep being disturbed by noise. Then came the reveal: he was sleeping on a bed in a department store.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个启示；揭露隐藏的事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这位喜剧演员一直告诉我们他的睡眠被噪音打扰了。然后真相大白：他睡在一家百货公司的床上。

flashcards.definition: Not having a precise meaning.
flashcards.example: a vague term of abuse
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有确切的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 模糊的滥用术语

flashcards.definition: A round or irregular patch on the surface of a thing having a different color, texture etc. and generally round in shape.
flashcards.example: The leopard is noted for the spots of color in its fur.
flashcards.definitionZh: 物体表面上的圆形或不规则斑块，具有不同的颜色、纹理等，通常呈圆形。
flashcards.exampleZh: 豹子以其皮毛上的彩色斑点而闻名。

flashcards.definition: A small child; an infant.
flashcards.example: This is the word Tiny.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个小孩；一个婴儿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是小字。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To transport toward somebody/somewhere.
flashcards.example: Waiter, please bring me a single malt whiskey.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）前往某人/某处。
flashcards.exampleZh: 服务员，请给我一杯单一麦芽威士忌。

flashcards.definition: The inside regions of a country, distanced from the borders or coasts.
flashcards.example: Sir Richard Burton explored far into the African interior.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个国家的内部区域，远离边界或海岸。
flashcards.exampleZh: 理查德·伯顿爵士深入非洲内陆进行了探索。

flashcards.definition: The outside part, parts or surface of something.
flashcards.example: The sticker was attached to the exterior of the package
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物的外部部分、零件或表面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 贴纸贴在包装外部

flashcards.definition: A call to a person or an authority for help, proof or a decision; entreaty.
flashcards.example: He made an appeal for volunteers to help at the festival.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向个人或权威机构寻求帮助、证据或决定；恳求。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他呼吁志愿者为节日提供帮助。

flashcards.definition: Spanning the world; global.
flashcards.example: A large meteorite impact would cause worldwide extinction of life.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跨越世界；全球的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 巨大的陨石撞击将导致世界范围内的生命灭绝。

flashcards.definition: To give public notice, especially for the first time; to make known
flashcards.example: This is the word Announce.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向公众发出通知，尤其是第一次；使众所周知
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“宣布”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A programme (bulletin, documentary, show, etc.) so transmitted.
flashcards.example: The DJ was feeling nervous before his first national broadcast.
flashcards.definitionZh: 如此传播的节目（简报、纪录片、节目等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: DJ 在第一次全国广播前感到紧张。

flashcards.definition: A body corporate, created by law or under authority of law, having a continuous existence independent of the existences of its members, and powers and liabilities distinct from those of its members.
flashcards.example: This is the word Corporation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由法律或法律授权设立的法人团体，独立于其成员的存在而持续存在，并且具有不同于其成员的权力和责任。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是公司这个词。

flashcards.definition: Favouring neither the supporting nor opposing viewpoint of a topic of debate; unbiased.
flashcards.example: I am neutral regarding the issue of gay marriage.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不赞成辩论主题的支持或反对观点；公正的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对同性婚姻问题持中立态度。

flashcards.definition: (usually with to or toward(s)) To design or devise (something) so as to be suitable (for a particular type of person or a particular purpose).
flashcards.example: They have geared the hotel mainly at tourists.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与“to”或“向着（s）”一起）设计或设计（某物）以便适合（针对特定类型的人或特定目的）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们的酒店主要面向游客。

flashcards.definition: Not moving.
flashcards.example: The train remained stationary for a few moments, before lurching forward along the track.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 火车静止了一会儿，然后沿着轨道倾斜地向前行驶。

flashcards.definition: To seize, as though with claws.
flashcards.example: to clutch power
flashcards.definitionZh: 抓住，就像用爪子一样。
flashcards.exampleZh: 离合器动力

flashcards.definition: To put (something) down, to rest.
flashcards.example: Set the tray there.
flashcards.definitionZh: 放下（某物），休息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将托盘放在那里。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word be worried.
flashcards.example: This is the word be worried.
flashcards.definitionZh: 担心这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是担心这个词。

flashcards.definition: An outlying area; area in proximity to something
flashcards.example: This is the word Surroundings.
flashcards.definitionZh: 边远地区；靠近某物的区域
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“环境”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To such an extent or degree; to the same extent or degree.
flashcards.example: It's not as well made, but it's twice as expensive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 达到这样的程度；达到相同的程度或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然做工不太好，但价格却贵了一倍。

flashcards.definition: A vessel for boiling a liquid or cooking food, usually metal and equipped with a lid.
flashcards.example: There's a hot kettle of soup on the stove.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于煮沸液体或烹饪食物的容器，通常是金属的，并配有盖子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 炉子上有一壶热汤。

flashcards.definition: A mechanical device for awaking people, or rousing their attention.
flashcards.example: The clock radio is a friendlier version of the cold alarm by the bedside.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种用于唤醒人们或引起他们注意的机械装置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 时钟收音机是床边冷闹钟的更友好版本。

flashcards.definition: A line or crease in the skin, especially when caused by age or fatigue.
flashcards.example: Spending time out in the sun may cause you to develop wrinkles sooner.
flashcards.definitionZh: 皮肤上的细纹或折痕，尤其是由于年龄或疲劳引起的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在阳光下度过一段时间可能会导致皱纹更快出现。

flashcards.definition: To join or attach something using glue.
flashcards.example: I need to glue the chair-leg back into place.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用胶水连接或附着某物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我需要将椅腿粘回原位。

flashcards.definition: A type of pre-formed packaging made from plastic that contains cavities.
flashcards.example: blister card
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种由塑料制成的预成型包装，内含空腔。
flashcards.exampleZh: 吸塑卡

flashcards.definition: A covering for the head attached to a larger garment such as a jacket or cloak.
flashcards.example: This is the word Hood.
flashcards.definitionZh: 连接到较大服装（例如夹克或斗篷）上的头部覆盖物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是胡德这个词。

flashcards.definition: A small cafeteria or snack bar, especially one in a military establishment, school, or place of work.
flashcards.example: This is the word Canteen.
flashcards.definitionZh: 小型自助餐厅或小吃店，尤指军事机构、学校或工作场所的自助餐厅或小吃店。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是食堂这个词。

flashcards.definition: To stew in an earthenware jug etc.
flashcards.example: jugged hare
flashcards.definitionZh: 用陶罐等炖。
flashcards.exampleZh: 锯齿野兔

flashcards.definition: A small ticket or sign giving information about something to which it is attached or intended to be attached.
flashcards.example: Although the label priced this poster at three pounds, I got it for two.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种小票或标志，提供有关其所附着或打算附着的物品的信息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然这张海报的标签标价为三英镑，但我却花了两英镑买了它。

flashcards.definition: The part of the palm of a hand closest to the wrist.
flashcards.example: He drove the heel of his hand into the man's nose.
flashcards.definitionZh: 手掌最靠近手腕的部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他将手掌根伸进了男人的鼻子里。

flashcards.definition: To anger or annoy.
flashcards.example: I think the boss's decision frosted him a bit.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使人生气或恼怒。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我认为老板的决定让他有点受挫。

flashcards.definition: A bizarre or whimsical creature.
flashcards.example: The children decided Grover was a cuddly monster.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种奇异或异想天开的生物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 孩子们认为格罗弗是一个可爱的怪物。

flashcards.definition: Any of various insects in the family Formicidae in the order Hymenoptera, typically living in large colonies composed almost entirely of flightless females.
flashcards.example: This is the word Ant.
flashcards.definitionZh: 膜翅目蚁科的任何一种昆虫，通常生活在几乎完全由不会飞的雌性组成的大群体中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是蚂蚁这个词。

flashcards.definition: A traveling company of performers that may include acrobats, clowns, trained animals, and other novelty acts, that gives shows usually in a circular tent.
flashcards.example: The circus will be in town next week.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由表演者组成的旅行团，可能包括杂技演员、小丑、受过训练的动物和其他新奇的表演，通常在圆形帐篷中进行表演。
flashcards.exampleZh: 马戏团将于下周进城。

flashcards.definition: To assist (sheep) to give birth.
flashcards.example: The shepherd was up all night, lambing her young ewes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 协助（羊）分娩。
flashcards.exampleZh: 牧羊人整夜没睡，正在给小母羊产羔。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: A body of text meant to be read line by line, especially in printed material that has multiple adjacent such on a single page.
flashcards.example: It was too hard to read the text across the whole page, so I split it into two columns.
flashcards.definitionZh: 需要逐行阅读的文本正文，尤其是在单页上有多个相邻文本的印刷材料中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 阅读整页的文字太困难了，所以我把它分成两栏。

flashcards.definition: Something resembling such a structure.
flashcards.example: a pillar of smoke
flashcards.definitionZh: 类似于这样的结构。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一根烟柱

flashcards.definition: The art and science of designing and managing the construction of buildings and other structures, particularly if they are well proportioned and decorated.
flashcards.example: Architecture is the visual public expression of a culture’s achievements, values, and outlook. ― Max Roscoe, "How Your City Is Killing You With Ugliness"
flashcards.definitionZh: 设计和管理建筑物和其他结构的建造的艺术和科学，特别是当它们比例和装饰良好时。
flashcards.exampleZh: 建筑是文化成就、价值观和观点的视觉公共表达。 ——马克斯·罗斯科，《你的城市如何用丑陋杀死你》

flashcards.definition: A professional who designs buildings or other structures, or who prepares plans and superintends construction.
flashcards.example: Plato made the causes of things to be matter, ideas, and an efficient architect.
flashcards.definitionZh: 设计建筑物或其他结构，或准备计划和监督施工的专业人员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 柏拉图将事物的原因归结为物质、观念和一位高效的建筑师。

flashcards.definition: The act of combining, the state of being combined or the result of combining.
flashcards.example: This is the word Combination.
flashcards.definitionZh: 组合的行为、组合的状态或组合的结果。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是组合这个词。

flashcards.definition: A sum or source of money.
flashcards.example: a fund for the maintenance of underprivileged students
flashcards.definitionZh: 一笔钱或钱的来源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 资助贫困学生的基金

flashcards.definition: To leave behind; to desert as in a ship or a position, typically in response to overwhelming odds or impending dangers; to forsake, in spite of a duty or responsibility.
flashcards.example: Many baby girls have been abandoned on the streets of Beijing.
flashcards.definitionZh: 留下；在船上或某个位置上开小差，通常是为了应对压倒性的困难或迫在眉睫的危险；尽管有义务或责任，但仍要放弃。
flashcards.exampleZh: 北京街头有不少女婴被遗弃。

flashcards.definition: To give something that is or becomes part of a larger whole.
flashcards.example: to contribute articles to a journal
flashcards.definitionZh: 给予属于或成为更大整体一部分的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 向期刊投稿

flashcards.definition: Any physical or metaphysical space in which a person or organization has free rein to do as they please.
flashcards.example: The exclusive tropical island was a millionaire's playground.
flashcards.definitionZh: 个人或组织可以自由行事的任何物理或形而上学空间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个独特的热带岛屿是百万富翁的游乐场。

flashcards.definition: Advertising or other activity designed to rouse public interest in something.
flashcards.example: This is the word Publicity.
flashcards.definitionZh: 旨在引起公众对某事兴趣的广告或其他活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“宣传”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The thing or property granted; a gift; a boon.
flashcards.example: I got a grant from the government to study archeology in Egypt.
flashcards.definitionZh: 授予的物品或财产；一份礼物；一个恩惠。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我得到了政府的资助去埃及学习考古学。

flashcards.definition: To be the setting or time of.
flashcards.example: 1999 saw the release of many great films.
flashcards.definitionZh: 是……的设定或时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 1999 年上映了许多伟大的电影。

flashcards.definition: To fail to hit.
flashcards.example: I missed the target.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以致未能击中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我错过了目标。

flashcards.definition: A person who is intentionally, physically, or emotionally cruel to others; especially to those who are weaker or have less power or privilege.
flashcards.example: A playground bully pushed a girl off the swing.
flashcards.definitionZh: 故意、身体或情感上残忍对待他人的人；尤其是对于那些较弱或权力或特权较少的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一名操场恶霸将一名女孩从秋千上推下。

flashcards.definition: The blow that drives the shuttle, used in calculating the speed of a loom (in picks per minute); hence, in describing the fineness of a fabric, a weft thread.
flashcards.example: so many picks to an inch
flashcards.definitionZh: 驱动梭子的打击，用于计算织布机的速度（以每分钟纬纱为单位）；因此，在描述织物的细度时，用的是纬线。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一英寸有这么多选择

flashcards.definition: A defensive position or effort.
flashcards.example: The Commander says we will make our stand here.
flashcards.definitionZh: 防守位置或努力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 指挥官说我们会坚守在这里。

flashcards.definition: A token; a sign; a symptom or indication.
flashcards.example: It sends some precious instance of itself/ After the thing it loves. Hamlet IV. v. ca. 1602
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个令牌；一个标志；症状或迹象。
flashcards.exampleZh: 它在它所爱的事物之后发送一些珍贵的自身实例。哈姆雷特四世。 v. ca. 1602

flashcards.definition: A performing engagement by a musical group; or, generally, any job or role, especially for a musician or performer.
flashcards.example: Hey, when are we gonna get that hotel gig again?
flashcards.definitionZh: A performing engagement by a musical group;或者，一般来说，任何工作或角色，尤其是音乐家或表演者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 嘿，我们什么时候才能再次参加酒店演出？

flashcards.definition: Happening or appearing in the relatively near future.
flashcards.example: The Federal budget lays out government spending for the upcoming budget year.
flashcards.wordZh: 即将推出 即将推出
flashcards.definitionZh: 在相对不久的将来发生或出现。
flashcards.exampleZh: 联邦预算列出了即将到来的预算年度的政府支出。

flashcards.definition: An increase by addition; accession
flashcards.example: an access of territory
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过添加而增加；加入
flashcards.exampleZh: 领土准入

flashcards.definition: To part, separate or divide.
flashcards.example: A metal comb shed her golden hair.
flashcards.definitionZh: 分开、分开或分开。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一把金属梳子梳理着她金色的头发。

flashcards.definition: The act of investigating; the process of inquiring into or following up; research, especially patient or thorough inquiry or examination
flashcards.example: Despite thorough investigation, the perpetrator of the attacks remains unknown.
flashcards.definitionZh: The act of investigating; the process of inquiring into or following up;研究，尤其是耐心或彻底的询问或检查
flashcards.exampleZh: 尽管进行了彻底的调查，但袭击的肇事者仍然未知。

flashcards.definition: To engage by feeling or sentiment; to interest.
flashcards.example: A good prince concerns himself in the happiness of his subjects.
flashcards.definitionZh: 凭感觉或情感参与；感兴趣。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个好的君主关心臣民的幸福。

flashcards.definition: To end; to come to an end.
flashcards.example: The story concluded with a moral.
flashcards.definitionZh: 结束；结束。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个故事以一个寓意结束。

flashcards.definition: To provide someone with an incentive to do something; to encourage.
flashcards.example: The weekly staff meeting was meant to motivate employees.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为某人提供做某事的动力；鼓励。
flashcards.exampleZh: 每周一次的员工会议旨在激励员工。

flashcards.definition: A contract to sell a security at a set price on or before a certain date.
flashcards.example: He bought a January '08 put for Procter and Gamble at 80 to hedge his bet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在特定日期或之前以设定价格出售证券的合同。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他以 80 美元的价格买入了宝洁公司 08 年 1 月的看跌期权来对冲他的赌注。

flashcards.definition: (usually with over) To complete.
flashcards.example: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与over）一起完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们说他们可以在两天内转动零件。

flashcards.definition: A contract to sell a security at a set price on or before a certain date.
flashcards.example: He bought a January '08 put for Procter and Gamble at 80 to hedge his bet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在特定日期或之前以设定价格出售证券的合同。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他以 80 美元的价格买入了宝洁公司 08 年 1 月的看跌期权来对冲他的赌注。

flashcards.definition: A contest, especially for spelling; see spelling bee.
flashcards.example: geography bee
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场比赛，尤其是拼写比赛；参见拼字比赛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 地理蜜蜂

flashcards.definition: A look; a glance.
flashcards.example: This is the word Peer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一看；一眼。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“Peer”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Behaviour; the manner of behaving
flashcards.example: Good conduct will be rewarded and likewise poor conduct will be punished.
flashcards.definitionZh: 行为;行为方式
flashcards.exampleZh: 良好的行为将得到奖励，同样，不良的行为将受到惩罚。

flashcards.definition: A person who takes tickets on public transportation and also helps passengers
flashcards.example: train conductor; tram conductor
flashcards.definitionZh: 在公共交通上取票并帮助乘客的人
flashcards.exampleZh: 列车长；电车售票员

flashcards.definition: A room, building or institution equipped for scientific research, experimentation or analysis.
flashcards.example: This is the word Laboratory.
flashcards.definitionZh: 配备科学研究、实验或分析设施的房间、建筑物或机构。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是实验室这个词。

flashcards.definition: To explain or tell the meaning of; to translate orally into intelligible or familiar language or terms. applied especially to language, but also to dreams, signs, conduct, mysteries, etc.
flashcards.example: to interpret an Indian speech
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或讲述其含义；将口头翻译成可理解或熟悉的语言或术语。尤其适用于语言，也适用于梦、符号、行为、神秘等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 翻译印度演讲

flashcards.definition: In one way or another; in a way not yet known or explained; by some means
flashcards.example: This problem has to be tackled somehow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以这样或那样的方式；以一种尚未知晓或解释的方式；通过某种方式
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个问题必须以某种方式解决。

flashcards.definition: An agreement between two or more parties, to perform a specific job or work order, often temporary or of fixed duration and usually governed by a written agreement.
flashcards.example: Marriage is a contract.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两方或多方之间执行特定工作或工作订单的协议，通常是临时的或固定期限的，通常受书面协议管辖。
flashcards.exampleZh: 婚姻是一份契约。

flashcards.definition: The result of a contest that neither side has won; a tie.
flashcards.example: The game ended in a draw.
flashcards.definitionZh: 双方均未获胜的比赛结果；领带。
flashcards.exampleZh: 比赛以平局结束。

flashcards.definition: A person or group of people constituting a particular side in a contract or legal action.
flashcards.example: The contract requires that the party of the first part pay the fee.
flashcards.definitionZh: 构成合同或法律诉讼中特定一方的个人或团体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 合同要求甲方支付费用。

flashcards.definition: To change (something) from a smaller form and/or size to a larger one; to spread out or lay open.
flashcards.example: You can expand this compact umbrella to cover a large table.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将（某物）从较小的形式和/或尺寸更改为较大的形式和/或尺寸；展开或摊开。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您可以将这把紧凑的雨伞展开以覆盖一张大桌子。

flashcards.definition: (usually with over) To complete.
flashcards.example: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与over）一起完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们说他们可以在两天内转动零件。

flashcards.definition: A piece of burning wood or peat, or a glowing cinder.
flashcards.example: To burn something to brands and ashes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一块燃烧的木头或泥炭，或发光的煤渣。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将某物烧成灰烬。

flashcards.definition: The person, place or thing from which something (information, goods, etc.) comes or is acquired.
flashcards.example: The accused refused to reveal the source of the illegal drugs she was selling.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物（信息、商品等）来自或获取的人、地点或事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 被告拒绝透露她所销售的非法毒品的来源。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: An upright open container used mainly for displaying fresh, dried, or artificial flowers.
flashcards.example: This is the word Vase.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种直立的开放式容器，主要用于展示新鲜、干花或人造花。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是花瓶这个词。

flashcards.definition: The maximum amount that can be held
flashcards.example: It was hauling a capacity load.
flashcards.definitionZh: 最大可持有金额
flashcards.exampleZh: 它正在牵引容量负载。

flashcards.definition: To subject to analysis.
flashcards.example: This is the word Analyse.
flashcards.definitionZh: 待分析。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“分析”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Decomposition into components in order to study (a complex thing, concept, theory etc.).
flashcards.example: This is the word Analysis.
flashcards.definitionZh: 分解成组件以便研究（复杂的事物、概念、理论等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“分析”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An insult.
flashcards.example: I don't mean this as a slam, but you can be really impatient sometimes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种侮辱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我并不是说这是一个大满贯，但有时你可能会非常不耐烦。

flashcards.definition: A sudden percussive noise.
flashcards.example: When he struck it with a hammer, there was a loud bang.
flashcards.definitionZh: 突然传来敲击声。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他用锤子敲击它时，发出一声巨响。

flashcards.definition: A place or institution for the confinement of persons held in lawful custody or detention, especially for minor offenses or with reference to some future judicial proceeding.
flashcards.example: This is the word Jail.
flashcards.definitionZh: 关押被合法拘留或拘留的人的场所或机构，特别是针对轻微犯罪或涉及某些未来司法程序的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是监狱这个词。

flashcards.definition: To fill with horror; to dismay.
flashcards.example: The evidence put forth at the court appalled most of the jury.
flashcards.definitionZh: 充满恐惧；令人沮丧。
flashcards.exampleZh: 法庭上提出的证据令大多数陪审团感到震惊。

flashcards.definition: A wide and unconstrained variety.
flashcards.example: In summer this flower garden is a riot of colour.
flashcards.definitionZh: 品种广泛且不受限制。
flashcards.exampleZh: 夏季，这座花园色彩缤纷。

flashcards.definition: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.
flashcards.example: The femur has a clean break and so should heal easily.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将某物分成两块或更多块的实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 股骨已完全断裂，因此应该很容易愈合。

flashcards.definition: To enter into; to make way into the interior of; to pierce.
flashcards.example: Light penetrates darkness.
flashcards.definitionZh: 进入；进入…的内部；刺穿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 光穿透黑暗。

flashcards.definition: A rejection letter, as for employment, admission to a school or a competition.
flashcards.example: John's not going to any of his top schools; he got a bullet from the last of them yesterday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 求职、入学或竞赛的拒绝信。
flashcards.exampleZh: 约翰不会去他的任何一所顶尖学校；昨天他从最后一个人身上中了一颗子弹。

flashcards.definition: To make resistant to failure.
flashcards.example: We have to bulletproof this program before we let the users at it; check every input, catch every possible flaw...it must not fail in use.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为了抵抗失败。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在让用户使用之前，我们必须先对这个程序进行防弹保护；检查每一个输入，捕捉每一个可能的缺陷……它一定不能在使用中失败。

flashcards.definition: To make resistant to transmitting sound.
flashcards.example: We soundproofed the room so we couldn't hear the road noises; unfortunately we couldn't hear the fire alarm either.
flashcards.definitionZh: 防止声音传播。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们对房间进行了隔音处理，因此我们听不到道路噪音；不幸的是我们也听不到火警警报。

flashcards.definition: To continue unchanged in place, form, or condition, or undiminished in quantity; to abide; to stay; to endure; to last.
flashcards.example: There was no food in the house, so I had to remain hungry.
flashcards.definitionZh: 地点、形式或条件继续保持不变，或数量不减少；遵守；留下来；忍受；持续下去。
flashcards.exampleZh: 家里没有食物，我只能挨饿。

flashcards.definition: Material used as bedding for animals.
flashcards.example: sleep in the litter
flashcards.definitionZh: 用作动物垫料的材料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 睡在垃圾堆里

flashcards.definition: A systematic plan of future action.
flashcards.example: This is the word Scheme.
flashcards.definitionZh: 未来行动的系统计划。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是计划这个词。

flashcards.definition: A finger-operated lever used to fire a gun.
flashcards.example: Just pull the trigger.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于开枪的手指操作杆。
flashcards.exampleZh: 只需扣动扳机即可。

flashcards.definition: To quickly search through many items (such as papers, the contents of a drawer, a pile of clothing). (See also rifflehttp//verbmall.blogspot.com/2008/05/riffle-or-rifle.html)
flashcards.example: She made a mess when she rifled through the stack of papers, looking for the title document.
flashcards.definitionZh: 快速搜索许多物品（例如文件、抽屉里的东西、一堆衣服）。 （另请参见 rifflehttp://verbmall.blogspot.com/2008/05/riffle-or-rifle.html）
flashcards.exampleZh: 当她翻阅一堆文件寻找产权文件时，她把事情弄得一团糟。

flashcards.definition: A shaking of the ground, caused by volcanic activity or movement around geologic faults.
flashcards.example: This is the word Earthquake.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由火山活动或地质断层周围的运动引起的地面震动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是地震这个词。

flashcards.definition: A type of women's undergarment, a slip.
flashcards.example: Just last week she bought a new shift at the market.
flashcards.definitionZh: 女式内衣的一种，衬裙。
flashcards.exampleZh: 就在上周，她在市场上买了一件新的衣服。

flashcards.definition: Currently unrealized ability (with the most common adposition being to)
flashcards.example: Even from a young age it was clear that she had the potential to become a great musician.
flashcards.definitionZh: 目前尚未实现的能力（最常见的副词是“to”）
flashcards.exampleZh: 即使从很小的时候起，她就很明显有成为一名伟大音乐家的潜力。

flashcards.definition: To work together with others to achieve a common goal.
flashcards.example: Let's collaborate on this project, and get it finished faster.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与他人合作以实现共同目标。
flashcards.exampleZh: 让我们合作完成这个项目，并更快地完成它。

flashcards.definition: A disadvantageous aspect of something that is normally advantageous.
flashcards.example: The downside of obtaining a higher rank is that far more work is expected.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通常有利的事物的不利方面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 获得更高级别的缺点是需要做更多的工作。

flashcards.definition: The opposite of something.
flashcards.example: We believed the Chinese weren't ready for us. In fact, the reverse was true.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与某事相反。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们相信中国人还没有准备好迎接我们。事实上，事实恰恰相反。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: A loss of greatness or status.
flashcards.example: the fall of Rome
flashcards.definitionZh: 失去伟大或地位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗马的陷落

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: To embrace by holding closely, especially in the arms.
flashcards.example: Billy hugged Danny until he felt better.
flashcards.definitionZh: 紧紧拥抱，尤其是抱在怀里。
flashcards.exampleZh: 比利拥抱丹尼，直到他感觉好多了。

flashcards.definition: A clue.
flashcards.example: I needed a hint to complete the crossword.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一条线索。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我需要提示才能完成填字游戏。

flashcards.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.
flashcards.example: As they accelerated onto the motorway, the wind tore the plywood off the car's roof-rack.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通常由对流或气压差异引起的实际或感知的大气运动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他们加速驶上高速公路时，风把车顶行李架上的胶合板刮掉了。

flashcards.definition: To separate (something that is wound up)
flashcards.example: Could you unwind about a foot of ribbon so I can finish the package?
flashcards.definitionZh: 分离（卷起的东西）
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能解开大约一英尺的丝带，以便我完成包裹吗？

flashcards.definition: A particularly boring event.
flashcards.example: The slideshow we sat through was such a yawn. I was glad when it finished.
flashcards.definitionZh: 特别无聊的活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们坐着看的幻灯片实在是太令人打哈欠了。当它完成时我很高兴。

flashcards.definition: The acquisition of title to, or property in, anything for a price; buying for money or its equivalent.
flashcards.example: They offer a free hamburger with the purchase of a drink.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有价获得任何事物的所有权或财产；以金钱或等价物购买。
flashcards.exampleZh: 购买饮料即可免费获得一个汉堡。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word look at.
flashcards.example: This is the word look at.
flashcards.definitionZh: 看这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是看这个词。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: To move from further away to nearer to.
flashcards.example: She’ll be coming ’round the mountain when she comes [...]
flashcards.definitionZh: 从较远的地方移动到较近的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当她来时，她会绕山而来[...]

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
flashcards.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）获得；获取。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definition: A thicket.
flashcards.example: This is the word Dense.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一片灌木丛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是密集这个词。

flashcards.definition: To fill initially empty items in a collection.
flashcards.example: Clicking the refresh button will populate the grid.
flashcards.definitionZh: 填充集合中最初为空的项目。
flashcards.exampleZh: 单击刷新按钮将填充网格。

flashcards.definition: Water or other liquid finely suspended in air.
flashcards.example: It was difficult to see through the morning mist.
flashcards.definitionZh: 水或其他液体精细地悬浮在空气中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 透过晨雾很难看清东西。

flashcards.definition: A state of mind characterized by lethargy and confusion.
flashcards.example: He did so many drugs, he was still in a fog three months after going through detox.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种以昏睡和混乱为特征的精神状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他吸毒太多，戒毒三个月后仍神志不清。

flashcards.definition: To get a smog check; to check a vehicle or have it checked for emissions.
flashcards.example: If the car is more than five years old, you'll have to have it smogged before you can register it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 进行烟雾检查；检查车辆或检查排放情况。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果汽车的车龄超过五年，您必须先对其进行烟雾处理，然后才能注册。

flashcards.definition: Generally; with everything considered.
flashcards.example: Overall, there is not enough evidence to form a clear conclusion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一般来说;考虑到一切。
flashcards.exampleZh: 总体而言，没有足够的证据来得出明确的结论。

flashcards.definition: An animal of the class Mammalia, characterized by being warm-blooded, having hair and feeding milk to its young.
flashcards.example: This is the word Mammal.
flashcards.definitionZh: 哺乳动物纲的一种动物，其特征是温血动物，有毛发并给幼崽喂奶。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是哺乳动物这个词。

flashcards.definition: (of body parts) Rigid, firm; standing out perpendicularly, especially as the result of stimulation.
flashcards.example: The penis should be fully erect before commencing copulation.
flashcards.definitionZh: （身体部位）刚性的，坚固的；垂直突出，尤其是受到刺激后。
flashcards.exampleZh: 开始交配前阴茎应完全勃起。

flashcards.definition: To fasten, to join to (literally and figuratively).
flashcards.example: An officer is attached to a certain regiment, company, or ship.
flashcards.definitionZh: 紧固、连接（字面意义和象征意义）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 军官隶属于某个团、连或舰艇。

flashcards.definition: A protrusion used to hang things on.
flashcards.example: Hang your coat on the peg and come in.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用来挂东西的突出物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 把你的外套挂在衣钩上然后进来。

flashcards.definition: The cast or structure of anything, or of any part of a thing, as of a landscape, a picture, a treaty, or an essay; any marked peculiarity or characteristic.
flashcards.example: one of the features of the landscape
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何事物或事物的任何部分的造型或结构，如风景、图画、条约或文章；任何明显的特性或特点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 景观的特色之一

flashcards.definition: To raise (someone) to a more important, responsible, or remunerative job or rank.
flashcards.example: He promoted his clerk to office manager.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将（某人）提升到更重要、更负责任或报酬更高的工作或级别。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他把他的职员提升为办公室经理。

flashcards.definition: A point at which reflected or refracted rays of light converge.
flashcards.example: The heat of sunlight at the focus of a magnifying glass can easily set dry leaves on fire.
flashcards.definitionZh: 反射或折射光线会聚的点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 放大镜焦点处的阳光热量很容易使干树叶着火。

flashcards.definition: The use of "damn" as a curse.
flashcards.example: He said a few damns and left.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使用“该死”作为咒骂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他说了几句脏话就走了。

flashcards.definition: A structure placed across a flowing body of water to stop the flow or part of the flow, generally for purposes such as retaining or diverting some of the water or retarding the release of accumulated water to avoid abrupt flooding.
flashcards.example: A dam is often an essential source of water to farmers of hilly country.
flashcards.definitionZh: 横跨流动水体放置的结构，用于阻止水流或部分水流，通常用于保留或转移部分水或延迟积水释放以避免突然洪水泛滥等目的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 大坝通常是丘陵地区农民的重要水源。

flashcards.definition: Something constructed from parts.
flashcards.example: Loops and conditional statements are constructs in computer programming.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由零件构成的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 循环和条件语句是计算机编程中的构造。

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: (heading) To interact socially.
flashcards.example: This is the word Engage.
flashcards.definitionZh: （标题）进行社交互动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“参与”这个词。

flashcards.definition: For, during, or involving less than the normal time for some activity, especially the number of hours an employee works.
flashcards.example: This is the word Part-time.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于、期间或涉及少于正常时间的某些活动，尤其是员工的工作小时数。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是兼职这个词。

flashcards.definition: Involving a full amount of time spent on some activity, especially a job.
flashcards.example: Bringing up a child is a full-time activity.
flashcards.definitionZh: 涉及将全部时间花在某些活动上，尤其是工作上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 抚养孩子是一项全职活动。

flashcards.definition: Indefinitely large numerically, many.
flashcards.example: There are numerous definitions of the word 'man'.
flashcards.definitionZh: 数量无限大，很多。
flashcards.exampleZh: “人”这个词有多种定义。

flashcards.definition: The name of the Latin script letter A/a.
flashcards.example: This is the word A DAY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉丁字母 A/a 的名称。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“一天”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of inviting; solicitation; the requesting of a person's company.
flashcards.example: an invitation to a party, to a dinner, or to visit a friend
flashcards.definitionZh: 邀请行为；招揽；某人的公司的要求。
flashcards.exampleZh: 参加聚会、晚宴或拜访朋友的邀请

flashcards.definition: To be grateful or thankful for.
flashcards.example: I appreciate your efforts
flashcards.definitionZh: 表示感激或感谢。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我很欣赏你的努力

flashcards.definition: What something does or is used for.
flashcards.example: This is the word Function.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物的作用或用途。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是函数这个词。

flashcards.definition: To include, comprise; to contain.
flashcards.example: This is the word Comprehend.
flashcards.definitionZh: 包括，包括；遏制。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是领悟这个词。

flashcards.definition: The most advanced or recent version of something; leading edge.
flashcards.example: the frontier of civilization
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物的最先进或最新版本；领先优势。
flashcards.exampleZh: 文明的边疆

flashcards.definition: To have (a person) enter an establishment, such as a hospital or asylum, as a patient.
flashcards.example: Tony should be committed to a nuthouse!
flashcards.definitionZh: 让（一个人）作为病人进入某个机构，例如医院或庇护所。
flashcards.exampleZh: 托尼应该被关进疯人院！

flashcards.definition: To discover or find by careful search, examination, or probing
flashcards.example: This is the word Detect.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过仔细的搜索、检查或探测来发现或发现
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“检测”一词。

flashcards.definition: The fact or condition of being present, or of being within sight or call, or at hand.
flashcards.example: Any painter can benefit from the presence of a live model from which to draw.
flashcards.definitionZh: 存在的事实或条件，或在视线范围内或呼叫范围内，或在手边。
flashcards.exampleZh: 任何画家都可以从现场模型的存在中受益，并从中进行绘画。

flashcards.definition: The upper legs of a seated person.

flashcards.definition: Following, afterwards in either time or place.

flashcards.definition: A statement or claim of questionable accuracy, from no known reliable source, usually spread by word of mouth.
flashcards.example: There's a rumor going round that he's going to get married.
flashcards.definitionZh: 准确性有问题的陈述或主张，来源不明，通常通过口口相传。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有传言说他要结婚了。

flashcards.definition: To express (an action, thought or idea) by means of particular words.
flashcards.example: I wasn't sure how to phrase my condolences without sounding patronising.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过特定的词语来表达（行动、思想或想法）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不知道如何表达我的哀悼而又不显得居高临下。

flashcards.definitionZh: 单词构建练习的含义。
